Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Rechnungswesen, im Treuhand oder in der Wirtschaftsprüfung gesammelt und möchtest den nächsten Schritt gehen? Dann passt diese Rolle.

Wir sind ein spezialisiertes Team für eingeschränkte Revisionen mit Fokus auf KMU, Vereine und Stiftungen.
Unsere Zusammenarbeit ist geprägt von hoher Eigenverantwortung, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer Arbeitsweise, die auf Vertrauen und Entwicklung basiert.
Während der Busy Season arbeiten wir fokussiert und intensiv zusammen. In ruhigeren Phasen profitierst du von spürbarer Flexibilität und zusätzlichen Freiräumen.

• Durchführen eingeschränkter Revisionen – selbständig oder mit gezieltem Coaching

• Übernehmen von Verantwortung für Mandate inklusive direktem Kundenkontakt

• Mitgestalten und Weiterentwickeln effizienter Prüfungsansätze

• Aufbauen und Weiterentwickeln eines eigenen Kundenportfolios

• Einsetzen moderner, digitaler Prüftools sowie aktives Mitgestalten von Prozessen

Warum du bei uns richtig bist
• Verantwortung: Selbständige Durchführung von Prüfungen und schnelle fachliche Entwicklung

• Impact: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen und Verantwortung für Mandate

• Flexibilität: Mehr Freiraum ausserhalb der Busy Season

• Entwicklung: Aktive Förderung deiner fachlichen Weiterentwicklung im Rechnungswesen, Treuhand oder in der Revision

• Viele unserer Mitarbeitenden haben nach ersten Jahren im Treuhand oder in der Prüfung bei uns den nächsten Entwicklungsschritt gemacht und ihr Profil gezielt weitergeschärft.

Was dich erwartet
Wir arbeiten in einem saisonalen Modell mit einer intensiven Busy Season von Januar bis April. In dieser Phase ist Einsatz gefragt – dafür profitierst du in den ruhigeren Monaten von mehr Flexibilität und Gestaltungsspielraum.

• Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Treuhand oder in der Wirtschaftsprüfung

• Fundiertes Verständnis von Jahresabschlüssen nach OR und betriebswirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen

• abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Strukturierte, effiziente und qualitätsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Freude an direktem Kundenkontakt und eigenverantwortlichem Arbeiten

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Was dich antreibt
• Wunsch nach dem nächsten Entwicklungsschritt und mehr Verantwortung

• Anspruch an fachlich saubere und effiziente Arbeit

• Bereitschaft, in intensiven Phasen vollen Einsatz zu leisten

• Interesse an einem Umfeld, in dem Leistung gesehen und Entwicklung gefördert wird

An fünf Teilschulen begleiten wir Lernende und Studierende auf ihrem Bildungsweg. Als Mitglied unseres zentralen IT-Teams erwartet dich ab dem 01.08.2027 eine vielseitige und praxisnahe Ausbildung als Informatiker/-in EFZ, Plattformentwicklung.

Deine Ausbildung

• Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören das Einrichten von IT-Arbeitsplätze und die Unterstützung unserer Mitarbeitenden bei technischen Anliegen.

• Du installierst, konfigurierst und betreibst Server-, Netzwerk- und Arbeitsplatzsysteme.

• Die Mitarbeit bei der Umsetzung von IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekten gehört ebenso zu deinen Tätigkeiten.

• Du analysierst technische Probleme und erarbeitest passende Lösungen.

• Schrittweise übernimmst du Verantwortung für eigene Aufgaben und Projekte.

Dein Profil

• Du interessierst dich für Informatik, digitale Technologien und die Möglichkeiten von Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI).

• Konzentration bei anspruchsvollen Aufgaben und abwechslungsreiche Arbeiten bringst du unter einen Hut.

• Auf dich ist Verlass, du bist verantwortungsbewusst und selbstständiges Arbeiten bereitet dir Freude.

• Du bist ein Teamplayer und bringst Geduld wie auch Ausdauer mit.

• Eine systematische Arbeitsweise wie auch logisch-abstraktes Denkvermögen sind für dich nicht nur Schlagwörter.

• Förderung der persönlichen Work-Life-Balance durch ein Jahresarbeitszeitmodell

• Teilzeitarbeit, auch im Kader

• Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten

• Fortschrittliche Anstellungsbedingungen auf Basis eines GAV

• Lohngleichheit zwischen Mann und Frau

• Treueprämien

• 16 Wochen Mutterschaftsurlaub bei vollem Lohn

• 2 Wochen Vaterschaftsurlaub

• Finanzielle Beiträge zur Kinderbetreuung

• Umfassendes Angebot an internen und externen Weiterbildungen

Michel Keppler
Stv. Direktor/Leiter Dienste
032 627 78 99

Per il Dipartimento di Altre Entrate/Occupazione, stiamo cercando un dipendente nella posizione di Solothurn, 80-100%.

La tua responsabilità

• Essi sono responsabili dell'esame e della valutazione delle domande di soggiorno dei cittadini stranieri.

Il tuo profilo

• Hanno un apprendistato commerciale o un'istruzione equivalente e un'esperienza professionale, idealmente nel campo della migrazione o dell'amministrazione pubblica.

• Il pensiero orientato alla soluzione e la capacità di far fronte bene con la pressione del tempo si distinguono così come l'interesse per le questioni legali. L'esperienza legale è un vantaggio.

• Il tuo profilo è arrotondato dalle competenze editoriali, dal tedesco alla moda e dalle competenze linguistiche straniere (francese, inglese e altro benefico) e dalle competenze digitali complete (Office, CMI, div.

• Pari retribuzione tra uomini e donne

• 2 settimane congedo di paternità

Capo dipartimento Altro ingresso/occupazione

In the canton of Solothurn, the Migration Office is responsible for migration and asylum law issues as well as for all tasks relating to identity documents for Swiss citizens. For the Department of Other Entry/Employment, we are looking for an employee at the Solothurn location, 80-100%.

Your responsibility

• They are responsible for examining and assessing applications for residence of foreign nationals.

• For this purpose, you carry out extensive factual investigations and issue residence, short-stay and border commuter permits.

• Further, you write demanding correspondence, legal letters and injunctions related to the subject matter.

• In contact with companies and authorities, you will advise them on issues relating to the granting of permits.

Your profile

• They have a commercial apprenticeship or equivalent education and professional experience, ideally in the field of migration or public administration.

• They are capable of teamwork and resilience, have a quick understanding and work independently, reliably and accurately.

• Solution-oriented thinking and the ability to cope well with time pressure distinguish you as well as the interest in legal issues. Legal experience is an advantage.

• Your profile is rounded off by editorial skills, stylish German as well as foreign language skills (French, English and other beneficial) and comprehensive digital skills (Office, CMI, div.

• Promoting personal work-life balance through an annual working time model

• Part-time work, also in cadre

• Opportunity to work mobile

• Progressive employment conditions based on a GAV

• Equal pay between men and women

• Loyalty rewards

• 16 weeks of maternity leave on full pay

• 2 weeks paternity leave

• Financial contributions to childcare

• Comprehensive offer of internal and external training

032 627 94 39

Convinced?

descriptionByLocale.it:
Vuoi la libertà del lavoro temporaneo e la sicurezza di un impiego a tempo indeterminato? Da 30 anni affianchiamo centinaia di aziende nei settori tecnici dell’edilizia, delle costruzioni e dell’industria in tutta la Svizzera, proponendo loro i migliori talenti. Non ti nascondiamo però che siamo esigenti. Quindi, se sei una persona motivata ed estremamente entusiasta, entra a far parte del nostro team per la posizione di Responsabile di progetto nel settore elettrico – È richiesto il diploma federale di esperto.

## Il tuo ruolo:
In qualità di responsabile di progetto nel settore elettrico, ricopri una funzione essenzialmente operativa e a stretto contatto con il campo. Dirigi le squadre, coordini gli interventi e partecipi attivamente al monitoraggio tecnico degli impianti.
Non si tratta di un ruolo che si svolge esclusivamente in ufficio: sarai regolarmente presente nei cantieri e in officina per controllare lo stato di avanzamento dei lavori, supportare le squadre e intervenire in situazioni tecniche complesse.
Le tue responsabilità:

## E ora parliamo di te?
Sei in possesso di un attestato federale nel settore elettrico. Un diploma federale di esperto in impianti e sicurezza elettrica costituisce un serio vantaggio.
Hai maturato una comprovata esperienza in Svizzera in qualità di caposquadra, responsabile di officina, capocantiere o responsabile di squadra.
A tuo agio sul campo, apprezzi il contatto diretto con le squadre e gli impianti. Sai prendere decisioni, gestire le priorità e fornire il tuo supporto durante interventi tecnici impegnativi.
Il tuo profilo:

## Ti interessa?
Ami e padroneggi il tuo mestiere e vuoi mettere le tue competenze al servizio di progetti che contano davvero?
Allora questa offerta è fatta apposta per te.
Da noi, la tua competenza fa la differenza e contribuisce direttamente al successo dei cantieri.

## 
• Cosa offriamo:
Il tuo referente per questa posizione è Nunzio Munafò. Saprà accompagnarti, consigliarti e rispondere a tutte le tue domande relative alla posizione.
Risponderemo solo alle candidature il cui profilo corrisponda alla descrizione richiesta.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per supportare il nostro team, stiamo cercando una personalità affidabile, motivata e impegnata per continuare a garantire i nostri elevati standard di qualità.

Cosa aspettarsi:

•
Potrai allenare e sostenere i nostri direttori di linea, dipendenti e project manager nella regione della Svizzera Centrale e Nord-Est in tutte le questioni specifiche H&S e l'attuazione delle misure

•
Siete regolarmente in loco, scambiate idee con i gestori degli impianti e avete un orecchio aperto per i nostri dipendenti “in campo”.

•
Insieme a coloro che sono responsabili nei luoghi, si effettuano valutazioni dei rischi e quindi garantire un ambiente di lavoro sicuro

•
Si sviluppa, progetta e coordina azioni e formazione per rafforzare e sviluppare in modo sostenibile la nostra cultura della sicurezza

•
Verifica se le specifiche del nostro Gruppo, i processi e i requisiti nazionali (ad es. SUVA) per la sicurezza e la tutela della salute sul lavoro sono aggiornati e costantemente implementati

•
In caso di eventi o incidenti, si arriva al fondo delle cose, identificare le cause e elaborare misure correttive nel team. Poi report i risultati nel nostro strumento Gruppo

•
Sei attivamente coinvolto nella gestione e nello sviluppo dei nostri sistemi di gestione (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001) nel campo della ghiaia e del cemento

• Porti la tua esperienza a gruppi di lavoro a livello CEW e mantieni il contatto con associazioni e autorità del settore

Cosa porti:

•
Hai una formazione tecnica (HF, FH, ETH) e l'esperienza nell'industria pesante

•
Lei è uno specialista di sicurezza EKAS, ingegnere di sicurezza o simile incl. Formazione obbligatoria

•
Hai già esperienza in un ruolo senior e sai come motivare i team e assumersi la responsabilità

•
Hai familiarità con l'industria dei materiali da costruzione o con un ambiente di produzione industriale paragonabile e ti senti a tuo agio tra impianto di miscelazione ghiaia e cemento

•
Hai una profonda comprensione dei rischi operativi specifici e istintivamente vedere dove dobbiamo iniziare ad aumentare la sicurezza

•
Le normative e gli standard legali (sicurezza del lavoro, protezione della salute, requisiti ambientali) sono i vostri strumenti quotidiani. Hai molto familiarità con gli standard ISO attuali (9001, 14001, 45001/OHSAS 18001)

• Porti l'esperienza pratica nell'attuazione dei progetti – non solo ti piace progettare, ma anche accompagnare misure fino al completamento di successo
descriptionByLocale.en:
To support our team, we are looking for a reliable, motivated and committed personality to continue to ensure our high quality standards.

What to expect:

•
You will coach and support our line managers, employees and project managers in the Central and Northeast Switzerland region in all subject-specific H&S questions and the implementation of measures

•
You are regularly on site, exchange ideas with the plant managers and have an open ear for our employees “in the field”.

•
Together with those responsible at the locations, you carry out risk assessments and thus ensure a safe working environment

•
You develop, plan and coordinate actions and training to sustainably strengthen and develop our safety culture

•
You check whether our Group specifications, processes and national requirements (e.g. SUVA) for occupational safety and health protection are up-to-date and consistently implemented

•
In the event of events or accidents, you get to the bottom of things, identify the causes and work out corrective measures in the team. You then report the results in our Group tool

•
You are actively involved in the management and further development of our management systems (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001) in the field of gravel and concrete

• You bring your expertise to work groups at CEW level and maintain contact with industry associations and authorities

What you bring:

•
You have a technical education (HF, FH, ETH) and experience in heavy industry

•
You are an EKAS security specialist, security engineer or similar incl. compulsory training

•
You already have experience in a senior role and know how to motivate teams and take responsibility

•
You are familiar with the building materials industry or a comparable industrial production environment and feel comfortable between gravel and concrete mixing plant

•
You have a deep understanding of specific operational risks and instinctively see where we need to start to increase safety

•
The legal regulations and standards (work safety, health protection, environmental requirements) are your daily tools. You are very familiar with the current ISO standards (9001, 14001, 45001/OHSAS 18001)

• You bring practical experience in the implementation of projects – you not only like to design, but also accompany measures until successful completion
descriptionByLocale.de:

Analyse & Conception

Accompagnement & Veille :

Profil

• Connaissances appréciées : SAP MDG, S/4HANA

• Compétences : animation d’ateliers, formalisation (processus, règles de gestion, spécifications), coordination multi-acteurs, approche orientée qualité et conformité

• Qualités : rigueur, autonomie, sens du service, pragmatisme, excellent relationnel

• Langues : français courant ; anglais professionnel

Conclusion

Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant, d’excellentes conditions de travail, des solutions de flexibilisation du temps de travail et des prestations sociales de premier ordre.

Nous vous remercions d'adresser un dossier de candidature complet (CV, lettre de motivation, certificats et diplômes).

Als solches muss sie sicherstellen, dass der Fortschritt der Investitionen innerhalb ihres Rahmens gut sichtbar wird, auch durch die Überwachung von Indikatoren und regelmäßige Kommunikation. Zuständigkeiten
• Teilnahme an Ausrüstungsbeschaffungsprojekten
• Pilot RETEX und interne Bedarfssammlung
• Folgen Sie den Fortschritten und stellen Sie die Einhaltung des Zeitplans sicher.
• Präsentieren und dann die Einhaltung überwachen
• Führende Partnerdienstleistungen
• Sichtbarkeit der Zeitpläne, Berechnung, Überwachung und Übermittlung von Fortschrittsindikatoren
• Gewährleistung der Wartung neuer Geräte und Vorbereitung der Geräte auf ihren Lebenszyklus
• Abschluss der Bilanzen Wartung und Logistik im Gange oder am Ende des Projekts Profil
• Ingenieur HES (oder gleichwertig) mit Erfahrung in Projektmanagement, Methoden oder Wartung
• Technische Kenntnisse und Instandhaltungsarbeiten
• Fähigkeit, ein multidisziplinäres Team zu koordinieren
• Erfahrung im Projektmanagement
• Beherrschung des Englischen B2 Minimum
• Teamgeist, Zuhören, gesellig und freundlich, einfache Kommunikation
• Geist der Analyse und Synthese, technische Neugier, unternehmerisch und autonom
• Kommunikation mit internen und externen Stakeholdern in der Abteilung
• Streng, methodisch, zuverlässig, mit einer Kultur der Verzögerung und Ergebnis
• Fähigkeit, neue Vorschläge zu machen, Fähigkeit, Erfolge herauszufordern Schlussfolgerung Wir bieten Ihnen ein anregendes Umfeld, hervorragende Arbeitsbedingungen, flexible Arbeitszeitlösungen und Top-Sozialleistungen. Vielen Dank für die Zusendung eines vollständigen Bewerbungspakets (Lebenslauf, Anschreiben, Zertifikate und Diplome).
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Introduction

Pour notre division Achats, Soutien et Infrastructure, nous recherchons un Chargé de projets Méthodes – Répondant Maintenance à l'investissement dont l a mission principale sera de représenter la maintenance dans les projets d’investissement, en assurant la préparation des machines à leur maintenabilité future, le suivi de leur état et de leur performance ainsi que l’évolution des besoins associés.

Il aura également pour rôle de piloter les activités des partenaires AS&I intégrés aux projets. À ce titre, il devra garantir une bonne visibilité sur l’avancement des investissements de son périmètre, notamment grâce au suivi d’indicateurs et à une communication régulière.

Responsabilités

• Participer aux projets d’acquisitions d’équipement

• Piloter les RETEX et le recueil des besoins internes

• Suivre l’avancement, assurer le respect du planning.

• Présenter puis contrôler le respect des prescriptions

• Piloter les activités des services partenaires

• Donner une visibilité sur les plannings, calculer, suivre et communiquer les indicateurs d’avancement

• Assurer la maintenabilité des nouveaux équipements et préparer l’équipement à son cycle de vie

• Réaliser les bilans Maintenance et Logistique en-cours ou de fin de Projet

Profil

• Ingénieur HES (ou équivalent) avec une expérience en gestion de Projet, Méthodes ou en Maintenance

• Connaissances techniques et des activités de la maintenance

• Capacité à coordonner une équipe pluridisciplinaire

• Expérience démontrée dans la gestion de projet

• Maitrise de l'anglais B2 minimum

• Esprit d’équipe, à l’écoute, sociable et avenant, communication aisée

• Esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, curiosité technique, entreprenant et autonome

• Communicatif avec les acteurs internes et externes au département

• Rigoureux, méthodique, fiable, ayant la culture du délai et du résultat

• Capacité de faire des propositions nouvelles, aptitude à remettre en cause les acquis

Conclusion

Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant, d’excellentes conditions de travail, des solutions de flexibilisation du temps de travail et des prestations sociales de premier ordre.

Nous vous remercions d'adresser un dossier de candidature complet (CV, lettre de motivation, certificats et diplômes).

descriptionByLocale.it:

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione Per la nostra divisione Sistemi Informativi, e in stretta collaborazione con la divisione Finanza, cerchiamo un Business Analyst per gli strumenti di consolidamento finanziario TAGETIK e di pianificazione finanziaria SAP BPC. La sua missione principale sarà quella di supportare i progetti, garantire la manutenzione evolutiva e correttiva degli strumenti, fornendo allo stesso tempo supporto funzionale e tecnico agli utenti. Responsabilità

• Garantire la manutenzione correttiva ed evolutiva dello strumento TAGETIK (configurazione, sviluppi, documentazione)
• Garantire il buon funzionamento, la manutenzione e il supporto degli sviluppi sulla soluzione SAP BPC (configurazione, sviluppi, documentazione)

• Redigere la documentazione tecnica e funzionale relativa agli sviluppi e ai processi
• Garantire la coerenza e la qualità dei dati di consolidamento
• Contribuire all'analisi e alla risoluzione degli incidenti e dei malfunzionamenti segnalati dagli utenti
• Anticipare le esigenze di evoluzione degli strumenti, in particolare in relazione alle evoluzioni normative (ESG, CSRD, Global Minimum Tax...)
• Effettuare una vigilanza sulle migliori pratiche nel campo del consolidamento e degli strumenti EPM Profilo
• Formazione superiore, Master o Bachelor in informatica gestionale, sistemi informativi o finanza aziendale
• Padronanza degli strumenti di consolidamento, in particolare TAGETIK (indispensabile per la parte EPM Consolidation)
• Conoscenze apprezzate sui moduli Global Minimum Tax, ESG - CSRD, Collaborative Office
• Esperienza con SAP BPC (modulo di pianificazione), un vantaggio
• Buone basi sulle regole e sui processi di consolidamento finanziario
• Capacità di redigere documenti tecnici e funzionali
• Autonomia, rigore, proattività e polivalenza
• Senso dell'organizzazione, spirito di analisi e di risoluzione dei problemi
• Eccellente comunicazione orale e scritta; capacità di semplificare argomenti tecnici per utenti non specializzati
• Attitudine alla relazione con l'utente e all'accompagnamento al cambiamento
• Capacità di lavorare in team e in modalità progetto con diversi interlocutori, principalmente nel settore Finanza Conclusione Le offriamo un ambiente stimolante, eccellenti condizioni di lavoro, soluzioni di flessibilità oraria e prestazioni sociali di alto livello. descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction For our Information Systems division, and in close collaboration with the Finance division, we are seeking a Business Analyst for the TAGETIK financial consolidation and SAP BPC financial planning tools. Your primary mission will be to support projects, ensure the evolutionary and corrective maintenance of the tools, while providing functional and technical support to users. Responsibilities
• Support projects related to consolidation using the TAGETIK tool (framing, deployment, developments, user support)
• Ensure corrective and evolutionary maintenance of the TAGETIK tool (configuration, developments, documentation)
• Ensure the proper functioning, maintenance, and support of developments on the SAP BPC solution (configuration, developments, documentation)
• Accompany users in the optimal use of the tools
• Write technical and functional documentation related to developments and processes
• Ensure the consistency and quality of consolidation data
• Contribute to the analysis and resolution of incidents and malfunctions reported by users
• Anticipate the need for tool evolution, particularly in connection with regulatory developments (ESG, CSRD, Global Minimum Tax...)
• Monitor best practices in the field of consolidation and EPM tools Profile
• Higher education, Master or Bachelor's degree in management information systems, information systems, or corporate finance
• Mastery of consolidation tools, particularly TAGETIK (essential for the EPM Consolidation part)
• Appreciated knowledge of Global Minimum Tax, ESG - CSRD, Collaborative Office modules
• Experience with SAP BPC (planning module), an asset
• Good understanding of financial consolidation rules and processes
• Ability to write technical and functional documents
• Autonomy, rigor, proactivity, and versatility
• Organizational skills, analytical and problem-solving spirit
• Excellent oral and written communication; ability to simplify technical subjects for non-specialist users
• Enjoy user relationships and change management
• Ability to work in a team and in project mode with various stakeholders, mainly on the Finance side Conclusion We offer a stimulating environment, excellent working conditions, flexible working arrangements, and top-notch social benefits. We thank you for submitting a complete application file (CV, cover letter, certificates, and diplomas).

descriptionByLocale.it: The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation. How you'll make an impact: Support in the implementation and management of the DTRS software system, ensuring it meets the functional scope for Distribution & Dry Transformers. Support in the deployment of automated test bay processes to reduce cycle time and improve testing efficiency. Participate\/conduct Test Room Audits to verify compliance with BU HSE Test Instruction 1LAA000050 and other applicable testing standards (IEC, CSA,IEEE) Review calibration processes on critical test equipment to ensure compliance with established intervals per 1ZBA 4505-118 Calibration Technical Standard. Coordinate with the GPG Test Process Expert, DT Factories, and other stakeholders to ensure proper compliance to the standard equipment & HSE Test Instructions.Support DT Factories and Business Solution Teams (BST) on Technical aspects & validation of onboarding special, design, and other tests. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external & internal regulations, procedures & guidelines. Your Background Degree in Electrical Engineering required. Strong experience in test management and coordination& Solid experience in transformer testing processes, high-voltage testing equipment, and relevant international standards. Familiarity with DTRS application, digitalization, automation processes, and test room audit procedures. Demonstrated experience engaging with and managing senior stakeholders in a global environment, supported by excellent communication skills and the ability to effectively balance business priorities and technical requirements. Fluent English communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage and collaborate with global stakeholders across different regions and functions. Willingness to travel internationally as required by business and project needs. More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical, and mental wellbeing, as well as your professional growth. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Attivo in Svizzera occidentale, aiutiamo i nostri clienti a realizzare i loro progetti fornendo soluzioni energetiche complete, efficienti e sostenibili, sia nella produzione e distribuzione di energia elettrica e calore, impianti elettrici, domotica, mobilità morbida, condizionamento dell'aria o trattamento dell'acqua. Come datore di lavoro esemplare, sosteniamo lo sviluppo delle competenze dei nostri 2250 dipendenti, tra cui 200 apprendisti, e la riconciliazione tra vita privata e professionale.

Gruppo E Tech, grazie alla sua competenza, è il partner di riferimento per progetti multi-tecnici nei settori degli impianti elettrici, tavoli e infrastrutture, telecomunicazioni, multimediali, solari, riscaldamento, ventilazione, aria condizionata, freddo, sanitario, trattamento acque e manutenzione degli impianti.

Missione:

Come leader del team, effettui e organizzi il lavoro relativo alle installazioni a media tensione (MT) all'interno dell'infrastruttura industriale. Stai guidando il tuo team per garantire un'esecuzione sicura, qualitativa e conforme. Le tue responsabilità:

• Partecipa attivamente al lavoro MT: installazione di celle MT, installazione e connessione di linee MT, installazione di trasformatori MT/BT e attrezzature associate.

• Gestisci, motiva e alloca le attività all'interno del tuo team garantendo un flusso di lavoro efficiente.

• Adapt gli interventi ai vincoli del campo e verificare la disponibilità, la condizione e il corretto utilizzo delle attrezzature MT specializzate.

• Controllare la conformità degli impianti elettrici, ottimizzare l'uso dei materiali e mantenere un ambiente di lavoro pulito e sicuro.

• Applicare rigorosamente le regole di sicurezza, verificare il DPI, identificare i rischi e interrompere immediatamente il lavoro in caso di pericolo.

• Effettuare i sondaggi, documentare le informazioni chiave e tracciare le esigenze e le lacune al responsabile della costruzione.

• Allena, supporta e valuta i dipendenti, garantendo al contempo la qualità del lavoro e la tempestività.

Profilo:

• Network elettricista CFC, installatore elettrico o formazione equivalente riconosciuto.

• Esperienza pratica confermata (5 anni) in installazioni a media tensione (cellule, trasformatori, linee, cablaggio).

• Prove capacità di inquadrare un team, trasmettere istruzioni tecniche e mantenere la coesione.

• Forte senso di sicurezza, rigore, organizzazione e reattività a situazioni impreviste.

• Persona dinamica, attenta, responsabile, orientata alle soluzioni.

• La patente.

Cosa offriamo:

• Un ambiente in evoluzione favorevole all'equilibrio della vita lavorativa

• Vantaggi sociali di un'impresa moderna, trattamento equo, opportunità di sviluppo professionale

• Uno spirito forte di coesione e un team orgoglioso di collaborare "Insieme, ci stiamo muovendo verso il successo"

Hai bisogno di maggiori informazioni?
Contatta Samuel Brügger, Construction Operator / Chief of Work 2, al +41 76 362 65 56.

Interessante? Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere l'applicazione completa cliccando sul pulsante "Post".

descriptionByLocale.en:
Active in Western Switzerland, we help our customers to carry out their projects by providing comprehensive, efficient and sustainable energy solutions, whether in the production and distribution of electricity and heat, electrical installations, home automation, soft mobility, air conditioning or water treatment. As an exemplary employer, we support the development of the skills of our 2250 employees, including 200 apprentices, and the reconciliation between private and professional life.

Group E Tech, thanks to its expertise, is the reference partner for multi-technical projects in the fields of electrical installations, tables and infrastructures, telecommunications, multimedia, solar, heating, ventilation, air conditioning, cold, sanitary, water treatment and maintenance of installations.

Mission:

As a team leader, you carry out and arrange for the work related to medium voltage (MT) installations within industrial infrastructure. You are operationally leading your team to ensure a secure, qualitative and compliant execution. Your responsibilities:

• Actively participate in MT work: installation of MT cells, installation and connection of MT lines, installation of MT/BT transformers and associated equipment.

• Manage, motivate and allocate tasks within your team while ensuring an efficient workflow.

• Adapt the interventions to the constraints of the field and verify the availability, condition and proper use of the specialized MT equipment.

• Control the conformity of electrical installations, optimize the use of materials and maintain a clean and secure working environment.

• Strictly enforce safety rules, verify PPE, identify risks and immediately stop work in case of danger.

• Carry out the surveys, document key information and trace needs and gaps to the construction manager.

• Train, support and evaluate employees, while ensuring the quality of the work and the timeliness.

Profile:

• Network electrician CFC, electrician installer or equivalent training recognised.

• Confirmed practical experience (5 years) in medium voltage installations (cells, transformers, lines, wiring).

• Proven ability to frame a team, transmit technical instructions and maintain cohesion.

• Strong sense of security, rigour, organization and responsiveness to unforeseen situations.

• Dynamic, careful, responsible, solutions oriented person.

• Driver's license.

What we offer:

• An evolving environment conducive to work-life balance

• Social benefits of a modern enterprise, fair treatment, opportunities for professional development

• A strong spirit of cohesion and a team proud to collaborate "Together, we are moving towards success"

Need more information?
Contact Samuel Brügger, Construction Operator / Chief of Work 2, at +41 76 362 65 56.

Interested? We look forward to receiving your full application by clicking on the "Post" button below.

Mission:

Als Teamleiter führen und arrangieren Sie die Arbeiten im Zusammenhang mit Mittelspannungsinstallationen (MT) innerhalb der industriellen Infrastruktur. Sie führen Ihr Team operativ, um eine sichere, qualitative und konforme Ausführung zu gewährleisten. Ihre Aufgaben:

• Aktive Teilnahme an MT-Arbeit: Installation von MT-Zellen, Installation und Anschluss von MT-Leitungen, Installation von MT/BT-Transformatoren und zugehöriger Ausrüstung.

• Verwalten, motivieren und zuweisen von Aufgaben innerhalb Ihres Teams und gewährleisten gleichzeitig einen effizienten Workflow.

• Passen Sie die Eingriffe an die Einschränkungen des Feldes an und überprüfen Sie die Verfügbarkeit, den Zustand und die ordnungsgemäße Verwendung der spezialisierten MT-Ausrüstung.

• Kontrollieren Sie die Konformität von Elektroinstallationen, optimieren Sie die Verwendung von Materialien und sorgen Sie für eine saubere und sichere Arbeitsumgebung.

• Strenge Durchsetzung der Sicherheitsvorschriften, Überprüfung der PSA, Identifizierung von Risiken und sofortige Einstellung der Arbeit im Gefahrenfall.

• Führen Sie die Umfragen durch, dokumentieren Sie wichtige Informationen und verfolgen Sie Bedürfnisse und Lücken zum Bauleiter.

• Trainieren, unterstützen und bewerten Sie die Mitarbeiter, während Sie die Qualität der Arbeit und die Aktualität sicherstellen.

Profil:

• Netzelektriker FCKW, Elektroinstallateur oder gleichwertige Ausbildung anerkannt.

• Bestätigte praktische Erfahrung (5 Jahre) in Mittelspannungsanlagen (Zellen, Transformatoren, Leitungen, Verkabelung).

• Bewährte Fähigkeit, ein Team zu bilden, technische Anweisungen zu übermitteln und den Zusammenhalt aufrechtzuerhalten.

• Starkes Gefühl von Sicherheit, Strenge, Organisation und Reaktionsfähigkeit auf unvorhergesehene Situationen.

• Dynamische, sorgfältige, verantwortliche, lösungsorientierte Person.

• Führerschein.

Was wir anbieten:

• Eine sich entwickelnde Umgebung, die die Work-Life-Balance fördert

• Soziale Vorteile eines modernen Unternehmens, faire Behandlung, Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Entwicklung

• Ein starker Geist des Zusammenhalts und ein Team stolz auf die Zusammenarbeit "Gemeinsam bewegen wir uns auf Erfolg zu"

Benötigen Sie weitere Informationen?

titleByLocale.fr: Regional Channel Partner Spécialiste

descriptionByLocale.it:
As Regional Channel Partner Specialist, you will serve as the primary link between our commercial team and our region network of distributors, reseller and dealers. Your mission is to scale our market presence by empowering partners with the technical knowledge, sales tools, and strategic support they need to succeed. The role is task to manage the entire partner lifecycle from scouting and onboarding new partners to driving revenue growth within established accounts. Aufgaben:
• Identify, recruit, and onboard high-performing channel partners in key geographic territories. Develop and execute strategic channel programs to drive significant sales growth and market share expansion through partner networks.
• Establish clear performance metrics and goals for each partner, aligned with overall channel objectives. Regularly monitor partner performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement corrective actions as needed
• Coordinate with the internal team to provide partners with deep-dive training product and services.
• Build strong, trust-based relationships with key decision-makers within partner organizations. Proactively identify and address partner challenges and roadblocks to ensure smooth collaboration
• Stay abreast of industry trends, competitor activity, and market conditions that may impact the channel landscape. Analyze partner performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. Generate comprehensive reports on channel performance, including sales results, pipeline metrics, and partner satisfaction levels. Anforderungen:
• Bachelors degree in business management or equivalent
• Minimum 5 years of experience in channel management, with a proven track record of success in driving significant revenue growth through partner networks. Prior sales experience and track records will be an added advantage.
• Proficiency in CRM system
• Proficiency in English, both spoken and written Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
LE CENTRE DE PNEUMOLOGIE DE L’HOPITAL D’YVERDON RECHERCHE

ACTIVITES PRINCIPALES

• Accueil des patients au centre de pneumologie

• Gestion de l’agenda des consultations

• Préparation et suivi des consultations

• Suivi des demandes des médecins et des patients

• Frappe des rapports médicaux

• Gestion des appels téléphoniques, des mails et divers travaux de secrétariat

• Possibilité, après formation, d’effectuer les tests respiratoires

COMPÉTENCES – EXIGENCES REQUISES

• Posséder un CFC d’employé.e de commerce ou équivalent

• Avoir un diplôme de secrétaire médical.e souhaité

• Posséder une première expérience réussie dans un cabinet médical ou dans un centre ambulatoire

• Maîtrise des outils informatiques usuels (pack office : Word, Excel, Outlook)

• Maîtrise de la terminologie médicale

• Une expérience dans le domaine de la pneumologie représente un atout

• Démontrer un sens de l’accueil, de la bienveillance et une attitude positive

• Aisance dans la gestion du stress et la gestion des priorités

• Sens du travail en équipe

NOUS OFFRONS

• Une activité pluridisciplinaire variée

• Des possibilités de formation continue

• Un salaire selon le barème de la Fédération des Hôpitaux Vaudois (FHV)

• D’excellentes prestations sociales

DATE D’ENTRÉE : 1er NOVEMBRE 2026 OU A CONVENIR

Des renseignements complémentaires peuvent être obtenus auprès de Mme Mélanie Correvon, Responsable administration des patients, T +41 24 424 42 19.

VOUS ÊTES INTÉRESSÉ.E ?

Les offres avec documents usuels (lettre de motivation, CV, diplômes et certificats de travail) sont à adresser d’ici au 20 septembre 2026.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Avrete una variegata attività, divisa tra la cura ambulatoriale e il follow-up apatici.
50% – Ufficio Fisioterapia Ambulatorio
All'interno del nostro ufficio, situato nei locali della clinica, si fornisce la cura per i pazienti con condizioni ortopediche, traumatologiche o neurologiche. Contribuirai anche allo sviluppo di questa attività ambulatoriale, offrendo un accompagnamento personalizzato per promuovere il ritorno all'autonomia, alla riabilitazione funzionale o alla preparazione fisica.
50% – Monitoraggio ospedaliero
Fornirete la gestione della fisioterapia per i pazienti in-patia, principalmente come parte del follow-up post-operativo in ortopedia, traumatologia e neurochirurgia, in stretta collaborazione con chirurghi, team sanitari e altri professionisti della salute.
Fisioterapia sportiva
Parteciperai anche alla nostra partnership con il Team AFF, fornendo circa 2 ore di follow-up fisioterapico a settimana con il team femminile di Granges-Paccot. Una grande opportunità per coloro che sono interessati a prendersi cura di atleti di alto livello.

• Diploma di fisioterapista riconosciuto in Svizzera o equivalente

• Interessi in fisioterapia muscolo-schelerica e follow-up postoperatorio

• Qualità relazionali eccellenti e senso di contatto con i pazienti

• Spirito di squadra, autonomia, senso di responsabilità e rigore

• Vuoi partecipare attivamente allo sviluppo dell'attività di fisioterapia ambulatoriale e ospedaliera

• Molto buona conoscenza del francese; Mastery of German è un vero bene

• Una posizione variegata che unisce ambulatorio, ospedale e fisioterapia sportiva

• stretta collaborazione con specialisti medici riconosciuti

• Una pratica fisioterapia integrata in una clinica privata dinamica

• Un ambiente di lavoro moderno, facile da usare, di dimensioni umane

• Un team impegnato e attento multidisciplinare

• Scommessa attraente e condizioni sociali

• L'opportunità di contribuire allo sviluppo di nuovi progetti all'interno del Clinique Générale

Data di entrata: ottobre 2026 o da concordare
Prestiamo grande attenzione alla diversità dei percorsi di vita dei nostri collaboratori. Le nostre posizioni sono aperte sia alle donne che agli uomini.

Il Clinique Générale e il suo staff accolgono i pazienti in un ambiente moderno e piacevole nel cuore della città di Friburgo. Il Clinique Générale offre cure mediche di alta qualità e follow-up personalizzato nelle seguenti aree: ortopedia, trauma muscolo-scheletrico, chirurgia, neurochirurgia, chirurgia, ginecologia e oto-rhino-laringologia (ORL).
Come parte del nostro sviluppo aziendale, stiamo cercando un fisioterapista al 100% per unirsi alla nostra squadra.
descriptionByLocale.en:
You will have a varied activity, divided between outpatient care and inpatient follow-up.
50% – Ambulatory Physiotherapy Office
Within our office, located in the clinic's premises, you will provide care for patients with orthopaedic, traumatological or neurological conditions. You will also contribute to the development of this outpatient activity, by offering personalized accompaniment promoting the return to autonomy, functional rehabilitation or physical preparation.
50% – Hospital monitoring
You will provide physiotherapy management for in-patient patients, primarily as part of post-operative follow-up in orthopaedics, traumatology and neurosurgery, in close collaboration with surgeons, health care teams and other health professionals.
Sport physiotherapy
You will also participate in our partnership with Team AFF, providing about 2 hours of physiotherapeutic follow-up per week with the women's team in Granges-Paccot. A great opportunity for those interested in taking care of high-level athletes.

• Diploma of physiotherapist recognized in Switzerland or equivalent

• Interest in musculoskeletal physiotherapy and post-operative follow-up

• Excellent relational qualities and sense of contact with patients

• Team spirit, autonomy, sense of responsibility and rigour

• Want to participate actively in the development of outpatient and hospital physiotherapy activity

• Very good knowledge of French; Mastery of German is a real asset

• A varied position combining outpatient, hospital and sports physiotherapy

• Close collaboration with recognized medical specialists

• A physiotherapy practice integrated into a dynamic private clinic

• A modern, user-friendly, human-sized working environment

• A committed and caring multidisciplinary team

• Attractive wage and social conditions

• The opportunity to contribute to the development of new projects within the Clinique Générale

Date of entry: October 2026 or to be agreed
We pay great attention to the diversity of life paths of our collaborators. Our positions are open to both women and men.

The Clinique Générale and its staff welcome patients in a modern and pleasant environment in the heart of the city of Fribourg. The Clinique Générale offers high-quality medical care and personalized follow-up in the following areas: orthopaedics, musculoskeletal trauma, hand surgery, neurosurgery, surgery, gynaecology and oto-rhino-laryngology (ORL).
As part of our business development, we are looking for a 100% physiotherapist to join our team.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Vous exercerez une activité variée, répartie entre la prise en charge ambulatoire et le suivi des patients hospitalisés.
50 % – Cabinet de physiothérapie ambulatoire
Au sein de notre cabinet, situé dans les locaux de la Clinique, vous assurerez la prise en charge de patients présentant des pathologies orthopédiques, traumatologiques ou neurologiques. Vous contribuerez également au développement de cette activité ambulatoire, en proposant un accompagnement personnalisé favorisant le retour à l'autonomie, la réadaptation fonctionnelle ou la préparation physique.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Endress+ Hauser, il progresso avviene lavorando insieme. Come leader globale nella strumentazione di misura, con oltre 18.000 dipendenti modellano il futuro nel campo dell'automazione dei processi. In qualità di azienda di proprietà familiare, guardiamo al di là delle mosse a breve termine e lavoriamo per creare una visione che è all'avanguardia per la nostra gente, i nostri clienti, e il mondo in generale. Stiamo cercando un Expert Global Production Master Data (f/m/d) per unirsi al nostro team e contribuire a porre le basi per un ambiente di produzione globale collegato, efficiente e pronto per il futuro in cui i dati fanno la differenza. Di che si tratta? Ti piace collegare complessi processi produttivi su scala globale? Sei entusiasta di utilizzare i dati per avere un impatto reale sulla qualità, l'efficienza e l'innovazione? Troverai un coordinamento internazionale e una collaborazione trasversale motivante? Se è così, ci si può aspettare un ruolo emozionante in cui si forma attivamente e sviluppare ulteriormente la spina dorsale digitale della nostra produzione globale. Quali compiti eseguirai? Lo farai:

• coordinare gli allineamenti complessi all'interno di una rete di produzione internazionale.
• definire, mantenere e garantire la qualità dei dati master di produzione, inclusa la configurazione delle varianti e garantire strutture di dati coerenti in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto.
• contribuire a e ottimizzare standard, processi e miglioramenti continui nella manutenzione dei dati master, guidando l'armonizzazione globale, la standardizzazione e l'ulteriore sviluppo della logica di processo sottostante.
• assumersi la responsabilità di responsabile del progetto (sotto) nei progetti di sviluppo dei prodotti per l'industrializzazione globale dei nuovi prodotti e delle attività di introduzione e di rollout transfrontalieri nell'ambito della rete manifatturiera internazionale.
• garantire il coordinamento e l'attuazione dei cambiamenti nell'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto come pianificatore di produzione responsabile del prodotto. Cosa ci aspettiamo da te? Tu...
• tenere una laurea in campo tecnico (ad esempio, ingegneria di produzione, ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria industriale, o simili) e hanno almeno 8 anni di esperienza professionale in un ambiente industriale, con comprovata esperienza nell'ingegneria produttiva, master data e ruoli di industrializzazione, così come l'esperienza internazionale.
• portare una forte conoscenza esperta nel mantenere i dati master di produzione SAP, in particolare in routing, bollette di materiali e configurazione delle varianti, insieme a una profonda comprensione di SAP ERP come sistema centrale per la gestione e l'integrazione di processi core come la gestione dei materiali, la pianificazione della produzione, la logistica e i dati master.
• hanno dimostrato esperienza nell'implementazione, nel roll out o nello sviluppo di SAP ME in un ambiente di produzione ricco di varianti e sono sperimentati nell'implementazione operativa di complesse dipendenze di sistema e processo tra il piano del negozio, SAP ME e SAP ERP.
• hanno almeno 8 anni di esperienza nella gestione del progetto e nell'industrializzazione di nuovi prodotti, l'introduzione di nuovi prodotti, processi o tecnologie, così come rollout cross-site in un ambiente internazionale.
• possedere una forte mentalità globale, competenze interculturali, e la capacità di gestire e coordinare efficacemente argomenti complessi in una rete di produzione internazionale e decentralizzata. È possibile valutare diversi requisiti, priorità, processi, livelli di maturità e condizioni locali dei siti di produzione internazionali e tradurli in soluzioni sostenibili, globalmente coerenti e implementabili.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Endress+Hauser, progress happens by working together. As the global leader in measurement instrumentation, with over 18,000 employees shape the future in the field of process automation. Whether developing and realizing new technology as a team, collaborating to build instrumentation, or strengthening vital relationships with countless global industries, we work to create trusted relationships that help everyone thrive. As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term moves and work to create a vision that is forward-thinking for our people, our clients, and the world at large.

We are looking for an Expert Global Production Master Data (f/m/d) to join our team and help lay the foundation for a connected, efficient, and future-ready global production environment where data makes the difference.

What is this position about?

Do you enjoy connecting complex production processes on a global scale? Are you excited about using data to make a real impact on quality, efficiency, and innovation? Do you find international coordination and cross-site collaboration motivating?

If so, you can expect an exciting role in which you will actively shape and further develop the digital backbone of our global production.

What tasks will you perform?

You will:

• work in a dynamic, globally operating team and collaborate across sites with production, engineering, and digitalization functions.

• coordinate complex alignments within an international production network.

• define, maintain, and ensure the quality of production master data, including variant configuration, and ensure consistent data structures throughout the entire product lifecycle.

• contribute to and optimize standards, processes, and continuous improvements in master data maintenance, driving global harmonization, standardization, and the further development of underlying process logic.

• take responsibility as a (sub-)project manager in product development projects for the global industrialization of new products and steer cross-site introduction and rollout activities within the international manufacturing network.

• ensure coordination and implementation of changes across the entire product lifecycle as a product-responsible manufacturing planner.

What do we expect from you?

You:

• hold a degree in a technical field (e.g., production engineering, mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, or similar) and have at least 8 years of professional experience in an industrial environment, with proven experience in production-related engineering, master data and industrialization roles, as well as international experience.

• bring strong expert knowledge in maintaining SAP production master data, particularly in routings, bills of materials, and variant configuration, along with a deep understanding of SAP ERP as a central system for managing and integrating core processes such as materials management, production planning, logistics, and master data.

• have proven experience in implementing, rolling out, or further developing SAP ME in a variant-rich manufacturing environment and are experienced in the operational implementation of complex system and process dependencies between the shop floor, SAP ME and SAP ERP.

• have at least 8 years of experience in project management and in the industrialization of new products, the introduction of new products, processes, or technologies, as well as cross-site rollouts in an international environment.

• possess a strong global mindset, intercultural competence, and the ability to effectively manage and coordinate complex topics in an international and decentralized production network. You can assess different requirements, priorities, processes, maturity levels, and local conditions of international production sites and translate them into sustainable, globally consistent, and implementable solutions.

• convince with a high level of communication, alignment, and integration skills across countries, functions, and locations, and have the ability to bring together diverse stakeholders with sometimes differing interests while sustainably harmonizing and optimizing global master data processes.

• are fluent in English, both written and spoken, and work in a structured, responsible and team-oriented manner.

What can you expect from us?

• We are a family-owned company with a strong commitment and a sustainable vision.

• We promote lifelong learning through diverse training and development opportunities, internal knowledge transfer, and e-learning.

• We support work-life balance with flexible working hours.

• We offer support for sustainable mobility solutions such as public transportation.

• We support family-friendly policies, including childcare places and childcare services during school holidays.

• We offer you a meaningful role with global impact in a stable and innovative working environment.

How do you apply?

To apply we kindly ask you to upload your documents on our career page. Applications sent to us by E-Mail can unfortunately not be considered due to Data Privacy Considerations.

Agencies, HR service providers, or similar entities are kindly requested to refrain from unsolicited submission of profiles and inquiries regarding potential collaboration. Currently, we do not engage with external service providers for this role. Any unsolicited applications will be disregarded and deleted without further consideration. We appreciate your understanding.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Contract Manager

__

The Global Spare Parts Forecasting Specialist serves as the central hub between ABB's Local Service Organizations (LSOs) across multiple countries and feeder factories supplying UPS spare parts. This role combines strategic demand forecasting with operational support for spare parts sales and service delivery. The primary focus is to ensure accurate demand signal capture, consolidation, and translation into actionable supply plans while supporting end-to-end spare parts management to achieve high-level service quality, operational efficiency, on-time delivery, order growth, and customer satisfaction.

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Develop and maintain rolling demand forecasts for spare parts, consolidating inputs from LSOs and incorporating installed base data, failure rates, service contracts, product lifecycle changes, and new product introductions.
  • Collaborate with supply chain, engineering, product management, manufacturing, and service teams to ensure parts availability, manage supply risks, and support EOL, ECN, lead time, and inventory planning activities.
  • Monitor forecasting and supply performance through KPIs and dashboards, identify demand anomalies, and drive corrective actions to improve forecast accuracy, service levels, and on-time delivery.
  • Drive continuous improvement of planning processes, forecasting tools, ERP data quality, e-commerce platforms, and automation initiatives while ensuring compliance with ABB’s HSE and integrity standards.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in spare parts planning, demand forecasting, service operations, or supply chain management.
  • Experience in power electronics, UPS, critical power systems, or industrial equipment is preferred.
  • Proficiency with ERP systems (e.g., SAP), forecasting tools, Excel/BI solutions, and e-commerce platforms.
  • Fluent English; additional European languages are an advantage.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset with the ability to develop and improve forecasting models.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-cultural communication skills, with the ability to translate complex inputs into actionable recommendations.
  • Solid knowledge of spare parts strategies, service operations, and process improvement, with a focus on service availability, delivery performance, standardization, and automation.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Service Contract Manager

Der Global Spare Parts Forecasting Specialist dient als zentraler Knotenpunkt zwischen ABBs lokalen Serviceorganisationen (LSOs) in mehreren Ländern und Feeder Factorys, die USV-Ersatzteile liefern. Diese Rolle kombiniert strategische Nachfrageprognosen mit operativer Unterstützung für den Verkauf und die Servicelieferung von Ersatzteilen. Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: hybrid #LI-hybrid

Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich sein für:

  • Entwicklung und Pflege von rollenden Bedarfsprognosen für Ersatzteile, Konsolidierung der Inputs von LSOs und Einbeziehung installierter Basisdaten, Ausfallraten, Serviceverträge, Produktlebenszyklusänderungen und Einführung neuer Produkte.
  • Arbeiten Sie mit Supply Chain-, Engineering-, Produktmanagement-, Fertigungs- und Serviceteams zusammen, um die Verfügbarkeit von Teilen sicherzustellen, Versorgungsrisiken zu managen und EOL-, ECN-, Vorlaufzeit- und Lagerplanungsaktivitäten zu unterstützen.
  • Überwachen Sie die Prognose- und Versorgungsleistung durch KPIs und Dashboards, identifizieren Sie Nachfrageanomalien und steuern Sie Korrekturmaßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Prognosegenauigkeit, des Serviceniveaus und der pünktlichen Lieferung an.
  • Steigende Verbesserung von Planungsprozessen, Prognosetools, ERP-Datenqualität, E-Commerce-Plattformen und Automatisierungsinitiativen bei gleichzeitiger Einhaltung der HSE- und Integritätsstandards von ABB.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle:

  • Bachelor-Abschluss in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering oder einem verwandten Bereich.
  • 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in Ersatzteilplanung, Bedarfsprognose, Servicebetrieb oder Supply Chain Management.
  • Erfahrung in Leistungselektronik, USV, kritischen Stromversorgungssystemen oder Industriegeräten wird bevorzugt.
  • Kompetenz mit ERP-Systemen (z.B. SAP), Prognosetools, Excel/BI-Lösungen und E-Commerce-Plattformen.
  • Fluent English; zusätzliche europäische Sprachen sind von Vorteil.
  • Starke analytische und datengesteuerte Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, Prognosemodelle zu entwickeln und zu verbessern.
  • Ausgezeichnetes Stakeholder-Management und interkulturelle Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Inputs in umsetzbare Empfehlungen zu übersetzen.

À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner de façon plus rationnelle et plus propre. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir pour grandir, et fier de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste relève de :

Gestionnaire des contrats de services

Le spécialiste mondial de la prévision des pièces de rechange sert de centre central entre les organismes de services locaux (OSL) d'ABB dans plusieurs pays et les usines d'alimentation fournissant des pièces de rechange UPS. Ce rôle combine la prévision stratégique de la demande et le soutien opérationnel pour la vente de pièces de rechange et la prestation de services. L'objectif principal est d'assurer la saisie exacte du signal de demande, la consolidation et la traduction en plans d'approvisionnement réalisables tout en appuyant la gestion des pièces de rechange de bout en bout afin d'atteindre la qualité du service de haut niveau, l'efficacité opérationnelle, la livraison à temps, la croissance des commandes et la satisfaction de la clientèle.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : hybride #LI-hybrid

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Élaborer et tenir à jour des prévisions de la demande de pièces de rechange, regrouper les intrants des ASL et intégrer les données de base installées, les taux de défaillance, les contrats de service, les changements du cycle de vie des produits et les nouvelles introductions de produits. Les résultats de l'enquête sont les suivants: Collaborer avec les équipes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, de l'ingénierie, de la gestion des produits, de la fabrication et des services afin d'assurer la disponibilité des pièces, de gérer les risques d'approvisionnement et d'appuyer les activités de planification des stocks, des délais et des délais de livraison. Surveiller le rendement des prévisions et de l'offre au moyen des ICR et des tableaux de bord, cerner les anomalies de la demande et prendre des mesures correctives pour améliorer l'exactitude des prévisions, les niveaux de service et la livraison à temps.
  • Favoriser l'amélioration continue des processus de planification, des outils de prévision, de la qualité des données du PGI, des plateformes de commerce électronique et des initiatives d'automatisation tout en assurant la conformité aux normes d'ESH et d'intégrité de l'ABB.

• Qualifications pour le rôle :

  • Baccalauréat en chaîne d'approvisionnement, affaires, génie, ou un domaine connexe.
  • 5+ ans d'expérience dans la planification des pièces de rechange, la prévision de la demande, les opérations de service ou la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.
  • L'expérience en électronique de puissance, en UPS, en systèmes d'alimentation critiques ou en équipement industriel est privilégiée.
  • Profiabilité avec les systèmes ERP (p. ex. SAP), les outils de prévision, les solutions Excel/BI et les plateformes de commerce électronique.
  • Fluent English; d'autres langues européennes sont un avantage.
  • Un état d'esprit analytique et fondé sur les données, capable de développer et d'améliorer les modèles de prévision.
  • Excellente gestion des intervenants et excellente communication interculturelle, avec la capacité de traduire des apports complexes en recommandations concrètes.
  • Connaissance approfondie des stratégies en matière de pièces de rechange, des opérations de service et de l'amélioration des processus, en mettant l'accent sur la disponibilité des services, la prestation des services, la normalisation et l'automatisation.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Chapter Lead

__

As an R&D Engineer, you will leverage your technical expertise to validate and customize OEM single-phase and three-phase low-voltage Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS), ensuring they meet the requirements of mission-critical power protection applications and market specifications.

Reporting to R&D Hardware Chapter Lead, based in Quartino Switzerland, you will contribute significantly to initiatives related to ABB’s Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS) products

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

Location: Quartino Switzerland

You will be mainly accountable for:

- Lead technical validation and customization of OEM 1ph and 3ph low voltage Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS), as well as batteries and accessories.

- Manage test partners (UL, Intertek, Dekra, Eurofins, etc.) to scope and plan test programs to demonstrate compliance with applicable IEC or UL standards.

- Manage the technical specifications of assigned products and support the Product Manager in developing the business case for product development.

- Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions related to issues found during qualification testing, as well as issues identified at customer sites.

- Maintain awareness of state-of-the-art technologies and collaborate with the research center in Switzerland and other ABB stakeholders to identify potential new UPS technologies.

• Qualifications for the Role:

- Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, along with more than two years of professional experience in electrical engineering.

- Experience working with power electronic systems is required.

- Experience in the use of various measuring equipment in a laboratory environment.

- Knowledge of product regulations and standards, including IEC and UL.

- Experience working with external laboratories and certification bodies.

- Knowledge of ECNs (Engineering Change Notifications), BOMs (Bills of Materials), and documentation systems.

- Experience with failure investigations and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

- Knowledge of and experience with Agile methodology is an advantage.

- Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Critical Power unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Diese Position berichtet an: Kapitel Blei

Als R&D-Ingenieur nutzen Sie Ihre technische Expertise, um OEM-Einphasen- und Dreiphasen-Niederspannungs-Unterbrechungs-Netzteile (UPS) zu validieren und anzupassen, um sicherzustellen, dass sie die Anforderungen von geschäftskritischen Leistungsschutzanwendungen und Marktspezifikationen erfüllen.

Berichterstattung an R&D Hardware Chapter Lead mit Sitz in Quartino Schweiz, Sie werden maßgeblich zu Initiativen im Zusammenhang mit ABB,s Produkten mit unterbrechungsfreien Stromversorgungen (UPS) beitragen

Das Modell der Rolle ist: hybrid #LI-hybrid

Ort: Quartino Schweiz

Sie werden vor allem verantwortlich sein für:

- Führende technische Validierung und Anpassung von OEM 1ph und 3ph Niederspannungs-Unterbrechungsfreie Stromversorgungen (UPS), sowie Batterien und Zubehör.

- Verwalten Sie Testpartner (UL, Intertek, Dekra, Eurofins, etc.) um Testprogramme zu planen und zu implementieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden IEC oder UL Standards nachzuweisen.

- Verwalten Sie die technischen Spezifikationen der zugewiesenen Produkte und unterstützen Sie den Produktmanager bei der Entwicklung des Business Cases für die Produktentwicklung.

- Antrieb root Ursache Analyse und Korrekturmaßnahmen im Zusammenhang mit Problemen während der Qualifikationstests gefunden, sowie Probleme an Kundenstandorten identifiziert.

- Bewusstsein für modernste Technologien zu bewahren und mit dem Forschungszentrum in der Schweiz und anderen ABB-Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten, um potenzielle neue UPS-Technologien zu identifizieren.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle:

- Master, s oder Bachelor, s Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, zusammen mit mehr als zwei Jahren Berufserfahrung in Elektrotechnik.

- Erfahrung mit elektronischen Systemen ist erforderlich.

- Erfahrung im Einsatz verschiedener Messgeräte in Laborumgebungen.

- Kenntnisse der Produktvorschriften und -normen, einschließlich des IEC und UL.

- Erfahrung mit externen Laboren und Zertifizierungsstellen.

- Kenntnisse der ECNs (Engineering Change Notifications), BOMs (Bills of Materials) und Dokumentationssysteme.

- Erfahrungen mit Fehleruntersuchungen und Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

- Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen mit der Agile Methodik sind ein Vorteil.

- Flüchtig in Englisch, sowohl gesprochen als auch geschrieben.

Mehr über uns

ABB Smart Power bietet Energieverteilungslösungen für Rechenzentren, Industrie- und Produktionsanlagen, kritische Infrastruktur und gewerbliche Gebäude. Die technischen Teams der Division arbeiten eng mit Industriepartnern zusammen und liefern fortschrittliche Lösungen, die schnelles Wachstum, Energiewende und Nachhaltigkeitsziele unterstützen. Das Portfolio der Division umfasst industrielle Schaltkreisbrecher, Niederspannungssysteme, Motorstartanwendungen und Sicherheitseinrichtungen wie Schalter und Relais.

Die Critical Power Unit unterstützt weltweit die größten Rechenzentrumsunternehmen mit fortschrittlichen energieeffizienten USV-Lösungen. ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager bietet eine skalierbare, einfach zu bedienende Plattform, die Unternehmen dabei hilft, Energie zu sparen und CO2-Emissionen zu reduzieren.

- Une expérience de travail avec les systèmes électroniques de puissance est nécessaire.

- Expérience de l'utilisation de divers équipements de mesure dans un environnement de laboratoire.

- Connaissance des règlements et des normes des produits, y compris la CEI et l'UL.

- Expérience de travail avec des laboratoires externes et des organismes de certification.

- Connaissance des CEN (notifications de changement de moteur), des BOM (Bills of Materials) et des systèmes de documentation.

- Expérience des enquêtes sur les échecs et de l'analyse des causes profondes (ARC).

- La connaissance et l'expérience de la méthodologie Agile sont un avantage.

- En anglais, parlé et écrit.

La Division, ses équipes techniques travaillent en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires industriels, fournissant des solutions avancées qui soutiennent la croissance rapide, la transition énergétique et les objectifs de durabilité.

Son unité de puissance critique prend en charge le monde, les plus grandes entreprises de data center avec des solutions UPS écoénergétiques avancées. La Division, ABB CapabilityTM Energy Manager fournit une plate-forme évolutive et facile à utiliser qui aide les organisations à économiser de l'énergie et à réduire les émissions de CO2.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Supervisor

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will work in plant engineering. We specialize in the construction of excitation systems for power plant generators and high-power rectifiers. A large portion of our systems are individually designed according to customer requirements, resulting in highly specialized solutions with significant technical added value.

The units for our customer projects are highly varied and diverse. At the same time, they require a solution-oriented, structured, and independent way of working in assembly. Technical clarifications and contributing to technical problem solving are part of everyday business.

Work model for the role is: onsite

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Assembly and wiring according to schematics, technical drawings, bills of materials, and assembly instructions
  • Mechanical tasks such as power busbar installation, minor mechanical modifications, and water cooling circuits
  • Final assembly of large components using crane systems
  • Ensuring compliance with quality, productivity, delivery, and occupational safety requirements, while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives

Our team dynamics

You will join a dedicated and highly qualified team that supports your professional development and values your contributions.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed vocational training as an Automation Technician or Electrical Installer
  • Experience in industrial plant engineering
  • Conscientious, reliable, independent, and deadline-oriented way of working
  • Fast learner with an efficient working style
  • Fluent German is required; good written and spoken English skills at a minimum B1 level
  • Strong computer skills and an affinity for IT

Benefits


• We offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Flexible working hours
  • Individual incentives and performance-based bonus opportunities
  • Subsidized meals (canteen)
  • Additional paid days off between Christmas and New Year
  • Fitness room and Ifa station

More about us

The Power Reliability business is part of ABB's Energy Industries division and is based in Untersiggenthal, Switzerland. We are a global leader in the development and delivery of excitation systems for power generation, with more than 120 years of experience in excitation technology and over 30,000 UNITROL® systems delivered worldwide.

Our solutions are used in hydro, thermal, gas, and nuclear power plants, as well as in industrial applications, and contribute significantly to the stability and reliability of modern power grids. With products such as the UNITROL® 8000, we continue to set new standards in digitalization, cybersecurity, and grid resilience.

ABB is a leading global technology company in electrification and automation, employing more than 110,000 people worldwide and building on more than 140 years of history.

The recruitment process is managed by Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

In dieser Funktion arbeiten Sie im Anlagenbau. Wir sind spezialisiert auf den Bau von Erregersystemen für Kraftwerksgeneratoren und Hochleistungsgleichrichter. Ein großer Teil unserer Systeme wird individuell nach Kundenanforderungen konzipiert, was zu hochspezialisierten Lösungen mit erheblichem technischen Mehrwert führt.

Die Einheiten für unsere Kundenprojekte sind sehr vielfältig und vielfältig. Gleichzeitig erfordern sie eine lösungsorientierte, strukturierte und unabhängige Arbeitsweise in der Montage. Technische Abklärungen und Beiträge zur technischen Problemlösung gehören zum Geschäftsalltag.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle lautet: vor Ort

  • Mechanische Aufgaben wie Installation von Stromschienen, geringfügige mechanische Modifikationen und Wasserkühlkreisläufe
  • Endmontage großer Bauteile mit Kransystemen
  • Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Qualitäts-, Produktivitäts-, Liefer- und Arbeitssicherheitsanforderungen und gleichzeitiger Beitrag zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen

Unsere Teamdynamik

> • Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung zum Automatisierungstechniker oder Elektroinstallateur
  • Erfahrung im Industrieanlagenbau
  • Gewisse, zuverlässige, unabhängige und terminorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Schneller Lernender mit einem effizienten Arbeitsstil
  • Fluent Deutsch ist erforderlich; gute schriftliche und gesprochene Englischkenntnisse auf einem Mindestniveau von B1
  • Starke Computerkenntnisse und eine Affinität zu IT

Benefits


• Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitern folgende Vorteile an:

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Individuelle Incentives und leistungsbasierte Bonusmöglichkeiten
  • Subventionierte Mahlzeiten (Cantine)
  • Zusätzliche bezahlte freie Tage zwischen Weihnachten und Neujahr
  • Fitness Room und Ifa Station

Mehr über uns

Mehr über uns

< Der Geschäftsbereich Power Reliability ist Teil der Division Energy Industries von ABB und hat seinen Sitz in Untersiggenthal, Schweiz. Wir sind weltweit führend in der Entwicklung und Lieferung von Anregungssystemen für die Stromerzeugung mit mehr als 120 Jahren Erfahrung in der Anregungstechnologie und über 30.000 weltweit ausgelieferten UNITROL®-Systemen.

Unsere Lösungen kommen in Wasser-, Wärme-, Gas- und Kernkraftwerken sowie in industriellen Anwendungen zum Einsatz und tragen wesentlich zur Stabilität und Zuverlässigkeit moderner Stromnetze bei. Ce poste relève de:

Production Supervisor

Votre rôle et responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez en ingénierie d'usine. Nous nous spécialisons dans la construction de systèmes d'excitation pour les générateurs de centrales électriques et les redresseurs de haute puissance. Une grande partie de nos systèmes sont conçus individuellement en fonction des besoins des clients, ce qui donne lieu à des solutions hautement spécialisées à forte valeur ajoutée technique.

Les unités de nos projets clients sont très variées et variées. Dans le même temps, ils exigent une façon de travailler en assemblée, orientée vers la solution, structurée et indépendante. Les clarifications techniques et la contribution à la résolution de problèmes techniques font partie des activités quotidiennes.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : sur place

  • Tâches mécaniques comme l'installation de barres d'autobus électriques, les modifications mécaniques mineures et les circuits de refroidissement de l'eau
  • Montage final de gros composants utilisant des systèmes de grue
  • Assurer la conformité avec les exigences en matière de qualité, de productivité, de prestation et de sécurité au travail, tout en contribuant aux initiatives d'amélioration continue

Notre dynamique d'équipe

Vous rejoindrez une équipe dévouée et hautement qualifiée qui appuie votre perfectionnement professionnel et valorise vos contributions.

  • Formation professionnelle complète en tant que technicien en automatisation ou installateur électrique
  • Expérience en génie industriel des usines
  • Mode de travail consciencieux, fiable, indépendant et axé sur les délais
  • Apprentissage rapide avec un style de travail efficace
  • Fluent German est requis; de bonnes compétences en anglais écrit et parlé à un niveau B1 minimum

Avantages

  • Profits incitatifs individuels et possibilités de bonus axés sur le rendement
  • Dépenses subventionnées (cantine)
  • Journées supplémentaires rémunérées entre Noël et le Nouvel An
  • Salle d'aisance et station d'Ifa

Plus à propos de nous

L'entreprise Power Reliability fait partie de la division Energy Industries d'ABB et est basée à Untersiggenthal, en Suisse. Nous sommes un leader mondial dans le développement et la livraison de systèmes d'excitation pour la production d'électricité, avec plus de 120 ans d'expérience dans la technologie d'excitation et plus de 30 000 systèmes UNITROL® livrés dans le monde entier.

Avec des produits tels que l'UNITROL® 8000, nous continuons d'établir de nouvelles normes en matière de numérisation, de cybersécurité et de résilience au réseau.
