descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Regional Sales Manager Europe for Excitation & Hydropower

__

Job • Profile Summary

Implements the sales strategy and drives the respective sales process in Hydropower and industries in collaboration with the Local Division Sales Manager and the Business Line Sales Manager Europe. Generates sales opportunities and secures profitable sales for ABB’s Energy Industries Division and its Business Line Power Reliability in Switzerland. Builds long-term customer relationships and ensures immediate response to specific customer needs and issues.


Core • Responsibilities

  • Focuses on new greenfield projects, as well as on Installed Base (IB) and brownfield penetration and sells the entire solutions portfolio (across automation, excitation, protection, electrification, grid code compliance studies, and digital solutions) in collaboration with other ABB units.

  • Sells entire solutions portfolio to expand ABB’s footprint in Switzerland and acts as a marketer/salesperson of ABB’s products and solutions during marketing activities (campaigns, trade fairs, exhibitions, conferences, customer meetings).

  • Establishes long-term customer relationships by understanding their requirements and translates the needs of customer into relevant ABB offerings and solutions.

  • Understands the channel strategy and the establishment of related prices and prepares sales plan, reviews them, and proposes recovery plan(s) when needed.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Experience in business development, technical sales or bids and proposals, ideally within the power generation, automation, electrification, or industrial sectors.

  • Strong solution selling and value proposition creation abilities, cybersecurity and digital solutions acumen.

  • Strong understanding of project dynamics and Installed Base (IB) concepts and confidently promoting value‑adding solutions.

  • Skilled in identifying, developing, and securing sales opportunities based on customer needs and market trends.

  • Customer-focused mindset with strong communication and negotiation skills, building long‑term customer relationships and responding quickly and professionally to customer issues.

  • Willingness to travel as required (up to 50%).

  • Ability to fluently communicate in German and English; additional languages are an advantage (French).

Kurzprofil der Position

Setzt die Vertriebsstrategie um und steuert den entsprechenden Verkaufsprozess im Bereich Wasserkraft und Industrie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem lokalen Divisionsvertriebsleiter sowie dem Business Line Sales Manager Europe. Generiert Verkaufschancen und erzielt profitable Verkaufsabschlüsse für die Division Energy Industries von ABB sowie deren Business Line Power Reliability in der Schweiz. Baut langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und gewährleistet eine schnelle und professionelle Reaktion auf spezifische Kundenanforderungen und Anliegen.

Hauptaufgaben

  • Fokus auf neue Greenfield-Projekte sowie auf die Durchdringung der installierten Basis (Installed Base, IB) und von Brownfield-Projekten. Verkauf des gesamten Lösungsportfolios in Zusammenarbeit mit anderen ABB-Einheiten, darunter Automatisierungs-, Erregungs-, Schutz- und Elektrifizierungslösungen, Netzanschluss- und Grid-Code-Compliance-Studien sowie digitale Lösungen.

  • Vermarktung und Verkauf des gesamten Lösungsportfolios zur Erweiterung der ABB-Marktpräsenz in der Schweiz. Repräsentation von ABB-Produkten und -Lösungen bei Marketingaktivitäten wie Kampagnen, Messen, Ausstellungen, Konferenzen und Kundengesprächen.

  • Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen durch das Verständnis der Kundenanforderungen und die Entwicklung passender ABB-Lösungen und Angebote.

  • Verständnis der Vertriebs- und Channel-Strategie sowie der entsprechenden Preisgestaltung. Erstellung und Überprüfung von Vertriebsplänen sowie Entwicklung von Gegenmaßnahmen und Aktionsplänen bei Bedarf.

Qualifikationen

  • Erfahrung in Business Development, technischem Vertrieb oder im Angebots- und Ausschreibungsmanagement, idealerweise in den Bereichen Energieerzeugung, Automatisierung, Elektrifizierung oder Industrie.

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Lösungsvertrieb und in der Entwicklung überzeugender Kundennutzenargumentationen sowie Kenntnisse im Bereich Cybersecurity und digitaler Lösungen.

  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Projektdynamiken und Installed-Base-Konzepten sowie die Fähigkeit, wertschöpfende Lösungen überzeugend zu positionieren.

  • Erfahrung in der Identifikation, Entwicklung und erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Vertriebschancen auf Basis von Kundenbedürfnissen und Markttrends.

Résumé du poste

Met en œuvre la stratégie commerciale et pilote le processus de vente correspondant dans les secteurs de l’hydroélectricité et de l’industrie, en collaboration avec le Responsable commercial local de la division et le Business Line Sales Manager Europe. Génère des opportunités commerciales et assure des ventes rentables pour la division Energy Industries d’ABB et sa Business Line Power Reliability en Suisse. Développe des relations clients durables et garantit une réponse rapide aux besoins et problématiques spécifiques des clients.

Responsabilités principales

Commercialise l’ensemble du portefeuille de solutions (automatisation, systèmes d’excitation, protection, électrification, études de conformité aux codes réseau et solutions numériques) en collaboration avec les autres unités d’ABB.

  • Établit des relations clients à long terme en comprenant leurs exigences et en les traduisant en offres et solutions ABB pertinentes.

• Qualifications requises

  • Expérience en développement commercial, vente technique ou gestion des offres et appels d’offres, idéalement dans les secteurs de la production d’énergie, de l’automatisation, de l’électrification ou de l’industrie.

  • Maîtrise courante de l’allemand et de l’anglais ; la connaissance d’autres langues, notamment le français, constitue un atout.

More about us

ABB’s Energy Industries Division is enabling safe, smart, and sustainable projects and operations for businesses across the oil, gas, chemicals, life sciences, power generation, and water sectors. Driving integrated solutions that automate, digitalize, and electrify operations across industries. The division strives to connect our people and technology capabilities, along with our robust global execution capacity and widespread service footprint to help customers adapt and succeed. With over 50 years of domain expertise, we continue to innovate and reshape traditional approaches across the energy sector with our technologies, that are designed to improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, decrease energy consumption and waste.

Our Benefits

descriptionByLocale.it:
In ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a funzionare più snello e cleaner.E ogni persona qui fa che accada. You.ll essere autorizzato a guidare, sostenuto per crescere, e orgoglioso dell'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e aiuta a gestire ciò che gestisce il mondo.

Questa posizione è riportata a: Performance e analisi dei rischi del Tesoro

E' un'idea divertente.

Unisciti al nostro team Corporate Treasury e svolgerai un ruolo chiave per garantire operazioni efficaci, governance e miglioramento continuo delle attività del Tesoro Middle Office. In questo ruolo, supervisionerai i processi critici del Tesoro, sosterrai le operazioni del Sistema di Gestione del Tesoro (TMS) e aiuterai a mantenere un solido ambiente di controllo tra i sistemi del Tesoro, i dati e le relazioni normative.

Collaborate con Treasury, Contabilità, Tecnologia, Controllo Interno e partner esterni per promuovere l'eccellenza operativa, migliorare i controlli, migliorare la qualità dei dati e sostenere le iniziative chiave del Treasury e gli aggiornamenti del sistema.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità

- Proprietà end-to-end dei principali processi globali del Ministero del Tesoro, garantendo una solida governance, controlli, documentazione ed efficacia operativa.

- Serve come principale esperto di materia del Ministero del Tesoro (TMS), funzionalità del sistema, miglioramento dei processi e esigenze aziendali.

- Fornire una supervisione funzionale di alto livello delle configurazioni del sistema e dei dati di riferimento, compresi gli strumenti finanziari, i portafogli, i dati di mercato, i limiti e le impostazioni di valutazione.

- Il sistema direttivo e i cambiamenti dei dati attraverso processi controllati, documentati e verificabili.

- Analisi e risoluzione di cause principali di complessi problemi operativi, di sistema, di dati e di contabilità tra più gruppi di stakeholder.

- Controllare e migliorare il Tesoro, comprese le riconciliazioni, il monitoraggio della qualità dei dati, la gestione delle eccezioni e limitare la sorveglianza.

- Possedere il processo di dati di mercato globale, garantendo completezza e accuratezza dei dati, integrità e miglioramento continuo.

- Guidare le attività di reporting e gestione delle esenzioni normative a livello globale, compresi EMIR, EMIR UK, Dodd-Frank e altri requisiti applicabili.

- Gestire il ciclo di vita globale dell'Identifier Legal Entity (LEI) e i relativi processi di master data.

- Sostenere progetti del Tesoro, implementazioni del sistema, attività di testing e iniziative di trasformazione dei processi con esperienza operativa approfondita.

Il tuo background

- Laurea magistrale in Finanza, Contabilità, Economia, Amministrazione aziendale, o un campo correlato.

- Esperienza significativa in Tesoro, Finanza o funzioni correlate all'interno di una multinazionale o di un istituto finanziario.

- Una forte comprensione delle operazioni del Tesoro, dei cicli di vita delle transazioni, dei sistemi di gestione del Tesoro, dei controlli, delle riconciliazioni e dei dati di mercato.

- Conoscenza degli obblighi di regolamentazione globale, compresi EMIR, EMIR del Regno Unito, Dodd-Frank e relativi quadri.

- esperienza nella gestione dei controlli, dei processi di qualità dei dati, dei rischi operativi e gestione delle eccezioni.

- esperienza di supporto alle implementazioni del sistema, testing, gestione dei cambiamenti e iniziative di miglioramento dei processi.

- Forte attenzione all'eccellenza operativa, con grande attenzione ai dettagli e alla capacità di gestire le attività ricorrenti, le priorità concorrenti e i risultati sensibili al tempo.

- Elevata integrità, forte responsabilità e giudizio professionale ben sviluppato.

Questa è l'occasione per svolgere un ruolo centrale nel rafforzamento e nell'ammodernamento delle capacità del Ministero del Tesoro all'interno di un'organizzazione globale. Se la governance, i controlli, i sistemi, i dati e il miglioramento continuo vi ispirano, e vi piace combinare proprietà funzionale con collaborazione cross-funzionale, accogliamo con favore la vostra applicazione.

Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente richiede ogni tipo di mente: il curioso, il coraggioso e il creativo. Ecco perché accogliamo persone provenienti da ogni provenienza ed esperienza.

Pronto a fare un impatto?

Applica oggi o visita https://www.abb.com per saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.

At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Head Treasury Performance and Risk Analytics

__

Join our Corporate Treasury team and play a key role in ensuring effective operations, governance, and continuous improvement of Treasury Middle Office activities. In this role, you will oversee critical Treasury processes, support Treasury Management System (TMS) operations, and help maintain a robust control environment across Treasury systems, data, and regulatory reporting.

You will collaborate with Treasury, Accounting, Technology, Internal Control, and external partners to promote operational excellence, enhance controls, improve data quality, and support key Treasury initiatives and system upgrades.

Your Role &
• Responsibilities

-
End-to-end ownership of key global Treasury Middle Office processes, ensuring robust governance, controls, documentation, and operational effectiveness.

-
Serve as the principal Middle Office subject-matter expert for Treasury Management System (TMS) operations, system functionality, process improvement, and business requirements.

-
Provide senior functional oversight of system configurations and reference data, including financial instruments, portfolios, market data, limits, and valuation settings.

-
Govern system and data changes through controlled, documented, and auditable processes.

-
Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of complex operational, system, data, and accounting-related issues across multiple stakeholder groups.

-
Own and enhance Treasury controls, including reconciliations, data quality monitoring, exception management, and limit oversight.

-
Own the Global Market Data process, ensuring data completeness and accuracy, integrity, and continuous improvement.

-
Lead the global regulatory reporting and exemption management activities, including EMIR, UK EMIR, Dodd-Frank, and other applicable requirements.

-
Manage the global Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) lifecycle and related master data processes.

-
Support Treasury projects, system implementations, testing activities, and process transformation initiatives with in-depth operational experience.

Your Background

-
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

-
Significant experience in Treasury, Finance, or related functions within a multinational corporation or financial institution.

-
Strong understanding of Treasury operations, transaction lifecycles, Treasury Management Systems, controls, reconciliations and market data.

-
Knowledge of global regulatory reporting requirements, including EMIR, UK EMIR, Dodd-Frank, and related frameworks.

-
Experience managing controls, data quality processes, operational risk issues, and exception handling.

-
Experience supporting system implementations, testing, change management, and process improvement initiatives.

-
Strong focus on operational excellence, with high attention to detail and the ability to manage recurring activities, competing priorities, and time-sensitive deliverables.

-
High integrity, strong accountability, and well-developed professional judgment.

This is an opportunity to play a central role in strengthening and modernizing Treasury Middle Office capabilities within a global organization. If Treasury governance, controls, systems, data, and continuous improvement inspire you, and you enjoy combining functional ownership with cross-functional collaboration, we welcome your application.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Fulfillment Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities
Join ABB and become a vital part of our supply chain, ensuring the seamless flow of materials from our global suppliers to our production lines. In this critical role, you will be the central point of contact for purchasing and fulfillment, where your planning and problem-solving skills will directly impact our ability to deliver high-quality products to our customers on time, every time.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly responsible for

  • End-to-End Order Management: Manage the entire purchasing lifecycle within SAP, from creating and releasing purchase orders to actively monitoring and expediting them to align with production schedules and customer delivery deadlines.

  • Supplier Performance & Partnership: Drive supplier excellence by monitoring key performance indicators such as on-time delivery, quality, and lead times. You will conduct performance reviews and proactively resolve issues to strengthen our supply chain partnerships.

  • Logistics Coordination & Problem Solving: Oversee the inbound logistics process, including freight and customs clearance. You will be the go-to expert for handling urgent delivery situations and managing non-conformance reports to ensure operational continuity.

  • Data Analysis & Process Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities to improve our fulfillment process by analyzing order backlogs, identifying root causes for delays, and implementing effective recovery plans. You will monitor and ensure the integrity of data exchanged through supplier EDI systems.

• Qualifications for the role

  • A degree or diploma in a technical field, Process Management, or Supply Chain Management.

  • Proven experience in a similar role within a manufacturing or industrial environment.

  • Strong, hands-on knowledge of SAP is essential for this role.

  • Excellent communication skills with fluency in both English and Italian.

  • A proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic setting.

  • Experience with order handling, inventory management, and data analysis would be a significant advantage.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment process is led by Pedro Labian Sanchez, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

In this role, you will lead a team of eight Project Managers and oversee a diverse portfolio of customer projects within ABB's Motion Traction division in Turgi, Switzerland. The work model is hybrid.

• Your responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop the Project Management team, setting performance expectations, coaching and mentoring team members, fostering engagement, and promoting a culture aligned with ABB's values and people-focused strategies.

  • Ensure successful delivery of customer projects, driving on-time, high-quality, and cost-effective execution while supporting bid activities, managing risks, and maintaining strong customer focus and stakeholder collaboration.

  • Bachelor's or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • 5-10 years of experience managing complex projects, including scope, budget, schedule, and supplier/subcontractor performance.

  • Previous experience leading a team of Project Managers is highly desirable.

  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills, with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

  • Fluency in German and English is required; additional language skills are considered an asset.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a funzionare più snello e cleaner.E ogni persona qui fa che accada. You.ll essere autorizzato a guidare, sostenuto per crescere, e orgoglioso dell'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e aiuta a gestire ciò che gestisce il mondo.

Questa posizione è riportata a: Performance e analisi dei rischi del Tesoro

E' un'idea divertente.

Unisciti al team di Treasury Performance and Risk Analytics e gioca un ruolo chiave nel supporto all'analisi quantitativa, alla trasparenza dei rischi e alla rendicontazione della gestione attraverso il Treasury. In qualità di manager responsabile delle performance e dell'analisi dei rischi, combinerai profonde conoscenze in materia di rischio finanziario, metodologie quantitative, dati e reporting per supportare processi decisionali informati e migliorare gli strumenti analitici del Treasury.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con i team di Treasury, Technology e Data Engineering, svilupperete soluzioni analitiche scalabili, migliorerete le metodologie di rischio e garantirete una governance robusta, controlli e standard di reporting nelle attività del Treasury.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità

- Gestire la progettazione, l'implementazione e il miglioramento continuo di analisi delle esposizioni del Tesoro, metodologie di rischio, approcci di valutazione e quadri di misurazione delle performance in FX, tasso di interesse, liquidità e rischio di credito di controparte.

- Sviluppare e mantenere metriche di rischio, analisi di scenari, misure di sensibilità e quadri di test di stress, garantendo una solida progettazione e validazione di metodologie.

- Fornire reporting di gestione basato su analisi, informazioni sulle prestazioni del Tesoro e raccomandazioni per sostenere il processo decisionale degli stakeholder senior.

- Definire requisiti analitici, logica di calcolo e standard qualitativi, collaborando strettamente con il Tesoriere Data Engineer per sviluppare soluzioni di scalabilità all'interno della Banca dati Treasury (TRDB).

- Convalidare dati e uscite di sistema per garantire completezza, accuratezza, tracciabilità e disponibilità all'analisi quantitativa.

- Sviluppare e migliorare reporting, dashboard e flussi di lavoro analitici automatizzati utilizzando strumenti come Power BI, Python, R e VBA.

- Garantire che le metodologie, i processi di rendicontazione e i controlli del Tesoro rispettino i requisiti normativi, le politiche interne e gli standard di audit.

- Mantenere una chiara documentazione di metodologie, modelli, controlli e processi di reporting a sostegno della governance e delle revisioni normative.

Il tuo background

- Laurea magistrale in Finanza, Econometria, Gestione del Rischio Finanziario, Matematica, Statistica, Ingegneria, o una disciplina quantitativa o finanziaria correlata.

- Esperienza significativa in Tesoro, Gestione del Rischio Finanziario, Analisi quantitativa, o un contesto di mercati finanziari comparabili.

- Approfondimento della comprensione del rischio di FX, tasso di interesse, liquidità e controparte, compreso il loro impatto sulla valutazione, i risultati finanziari, il bilancio, i flussi finanziari e i risultati del Tesoro.

- Esperienza dimostrata con analisi quantitative, modellizzazione finanziaria, approcci di valutazione, test di stress e metriche di performance.

- Abilità avanzate di programmazione e analisi, compresa l'esperienza con Power BI, Python, R, VBA o strumenti comparabili.

- Esperienza lavorando con i Sistemi di Gestione del Tesoro, le piattaforme di dati di mercato e gli ambienti di reporting analitico.

- Una solida comprensione dei principi contabili e degli obblighi di informativa finanziaria pertinenti alle attività del Tesoro, compresi i Principi contabili statunitensi.

- Problem-solving altamente sviluppato, collaborazione delle parti interessate e capacità decisionali, con un'attenzione costante alla qualità, controlli e miglioramento continuo.

- Elevato livello di integrità, giudizio professionale e attenzione ai dettagli.

Questa è un'opportunità unica per modellare le performance del Tesoro e l'analisi dei rischi a livello strategico, supportando il processo decisionale basato sui dati in un'organizzazione globale. Se siete interessati ad applicare le competenze in materia di rischio finanziario insieme ad analisi avanzate e reporting, vi invitiamo a fare domanda.

Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente richiede ogni tipo di mente: il curioso, il coraggioso e il creativo. Ecco perché accogliamo persone provenienti da ogni provenienza ed esperienza.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Head Treasury Performance and Risk Analytics

__

Join the Treasury Performance and Risk Analytics team and play a key role in supporting quantitative analytics, risk transparency, and management reporting across Treasury. As the manager responsible for performance and risk analytics, you will combine deep knowledge in financial risk, quantitative methodologies, data, and reporting to support informed decision-making and improve Treasury's analytical tools.

Working closely with Treasury, Technology, and Data Engineering teams, you will develop scalable analytical solutions, enhance risk methodologies, and ensure robust governance, controls, and reporting standards across Treasury activities.

Your Role &
• Responsibilities

-
Manage the design, implementation, and continuous enhancement of Treasury exposure analytics, risk methodologies, valuation approaches, and performance measurement frameworks across FX, interest rate, liquidity, and counterparty credit risk.

-
Develop and maintain risk metrics, scenario analyses, sensitivity measures, and stress-testing frameworks, ensuring robust methodology design and validation.

-
Deliver analytics-driven management reporting, Treasury performance insights, and recommendations to support senior stakeholder decision-making.

-
Define analytical data requirements, calculation logic, and quality standards, collaborating closely with the Treasury Data Engineer to develop scalable solutions within the Treasury Database (TRDB).

-
Validate data and system outputs to ensure completeness, accuracy, traceability, and readiness for quantitative analysis.

-
Develop and enhance reporting, dashboards, and automated analytical workflows using tools such as Power BI, Python, R, and VBA.

-
Ensure Treasury methodologies, reporting processes, and controls comply with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and audit standards.

-
Maintain clear documentation of methodologies, models, controls, and reporting processes to support governance and regulatory reviews.

Your Background

-
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Econometrics, Financial Risk Management, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative or financial discipline.

-
Significant experience in Treasury, Financial Risk Management, Quantitative Analytics, or a comparable financial markets environment.

-
Deep understanding of FX, interest rate, liquidity, and counterparty credit risk, including their impact on valuation, financial results, balance sheet, cash flows, and Treasury performance.

-
Demonstrated experience with quantitative analysis, financial modeling, valuation approaches, stress testing, and performance metrics.

-
Advanced programming and analytics skills, including experience with Power BI, Python, R, VBA, or comparable tools.

-
Experience working with Treasury Management Systems, market data platforms, and analytical reporting environments.

-
Solid understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting requirements relevant to Treasury activities, including US GAAP.

-
Highly developed problem-solving, stakeholder collaboration, and decision-making skills, with a consistent focus on quality, controls, and ongoing improvement.

-
High level of integrity, professional judgment, and attention to detail.

This is a unique opportunity to shape Treasury performance and risk analytics at a strategic level, supporting data-driven decision-making across a global organization. If you are interested in applying financial risk skills alongside advanced analytics and reporting, we invite you to apply.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

En tant que gestionnaire responsable de l'analyse du rendement et du risque, vous combinerez des connaissances approfondies sur les risques financiers, les méthodologies quantitatives, les données et les rapports pour appuyer la prise de décisions éclairées et améliorer les outils analytiques du Trésor.

- Maintenir une documentation claire des méthodes, des modèles, des contrôles et des processus de rapport pour appuyer la gouvernance et les examens réglementaires.

- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en finance, économétrie, gestion des risques financiers, mathématiques, statistiques, génie ou une discipline quantitative ou financière connexe.

- Expérience significative en trésorerie, gestion des risques financiers, analyse quantitative ou environnement comparable des marchés financiers.

- Une compréhension approfondie des risques de crédit FX, taux d'intérêt, liquidité et contrepartie, y compris leur incidence sur l'évaluation, les résultats financiers, le bilan, les flux de trésorerie et les performances du Trésor.

- Une bonne compréhension des principes comptables et des exigences en matière d'information financière applicables aux activités du Trésor, y compris les PCGR des États-Unis.

- La résolution de problèmes, la collaboration avec les intervenants et les compétences décisionnelles, en mettant l'accent sur la qualité, les contrôles et l'amélioration continue.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Procurement Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

The Global Procurement Specialist / Global Category Specialist for Power Electronics Components is a senior individual contributor responsible for developing and executing global category strategies for key power semiconductor and passive components used across ABB's power electronics product lines. The role requires deep technical knowledge of power electronics BOMs, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to manage complex, multi-site supplier relationships globally.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

Your main accountabilities will be to:
  • Define and execute global category sourcing strategies for IGBTs, Film/Electrolytic Capacitors, SCRs, Thyristors, Displays, and Fuses.
  • Lead global RFQ/RFP processes; conduct TCO analysis, cost benchmarking, and commercial negotiations with tier-1 and strategic semiconductor suppliers.
  • Develop and maintain long-term agreements (LTAs) and global frame contracts with key suppliers (e.g. Infineon, ABB Semiconductors, Vishay, KYOCERA, Eaton, Littelfuse, etc.).
  • Manage supplier qualification and onboarding in collaboration with Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE) and R&D teams.
  • Analyse global spend, supplier concentration, and market trends; develop dual-source and multi-source strategies to mitigate supply risk.
  • Monitor power semiconductor market dynamics (silicon, SiC, GaN), component lifecycle, and obsolescence management; implement last-time-buy strategies.
  • Drive year-over-year cost savings through volume consolidation, competitive sourcing, design-to-cost, and VA/VE initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and NPI teams globally to influence component selection and ensure strategic alignment from product concept through mass production.
  • Manage end-to-end contract lifecycle: drafting, review, execution, and compliance monitoring.
  • Report category performance (cost savings, OTD, quality, risk) to senior management on a regular basis.
  • Support global sites (Bangalore, Quartino, Richmond, Frosinone, and others) in executing local procurement aligned with global category strategy.
  • Ensure full compliance with ABB procurement policies, trade-compliance requirements (export control, sanctions), and supplier sustainability (ESG) standards.


Key Performance Indicators

  • Annual cost savings vs. target (PPV, negotiated savings)
  • Supplier On-Time Delivery (OTD) and quality performance
  • LTA / frame contract coverage (% of category spend)
  • Single-source risk reduction (dual-source coverage rate)
  • Component obsolescence incidents and resolution time
  • Supplier sustainability (ESG) assessment coverage

Our team dynamics
You will join a dynamic team, where you will be able to thrive.



• Qualifications for the role
  • Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics/Power Electronics Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or related field.
  • 5–12 years of experience in strategic procurement or category management for power electronics or semiconductor components.
  • Deep technical understanding of IGBTs, thyristors, SCRs, capacitors, fuses, and display technologies used in industrial power electronics.
  • Proven track record in global supplier negotiations, LTA management, and category strategy execution.
  • Familiarity with power electronics products (drives, converters, UPS, traction, renewable energy systems) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, or similar sourcing platforms; advanced MS Excel and Power BI skills.
  • Ability and willingness to travel internationally (up to 20–30%).
  • Fluent English (mandatory); Italian, German, or Spanish is an advantage depending on location.
  • Professional certifications (CPSM, CIPS, or equivalent) are a plus.

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.
The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, was die Welt regiert.

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

Der Global Procurement Specialist / Global Category Specialist for Power Electronics Components ist ein leitender Mitarbeiter, der für die Entwicklung und Durchführung globaler Kategoriestrategien für wichtige Leistungshalbleiter und passive Komponenten verantwortlich ist, die in den Leistungselektronik-Produktlinien von ABB verwendet werden. Die Rolle erfordert tiefes technisches Wissen über Leistungselektronik-Stücklisten, starken kommerziellen Scharfsinn und die Fähigkeit, komplexe, standortübergreifende Lieferantenbeziehungen weltweit zu verwalten.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: hybrid

Ihre Hauptverantwortlichkeiten werden sein:
  • Definieren und Ausführen globaler Kategorienbeschaffungsstrategien für IGBTs, Film/Elektrolytische Kondensatoren, SCRs, Thyristoren, Displays und Sicherungen.
  • Führen Sie globale RFQ / RFP-Prozesse; Durchführung von TCO-Analysen, Kostenbenchmarking und kommerziellen Verhandlungen mit Tier-1- und strategischen Halbleiterlieferanten. Entwicklung und Aufrechterhaltung langfristiger Verträge (LTAs) und globaler Rahmenverträge mit wichtigen Lieferanten (z. B. Infineon, ABB Semiconductors, Vishay, KYOCERA, Eaton, Littelfuse usw.). Verwalten Sie die Qualifizierung und das Onboarding von Lieferanten in Zusammenarbeit mit Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE) und R&D-Teams.
  • Analyse der globalen Ausgaben, der Lieferantenkonzentration und der Markttrends; Entwicklung von Dual-Source- und Multi-Source-Strategien zur Minderung des Versorgungsrisikos.
  • Monitor der Marktdynamik von Leistungshalbleitern (Silizium, SiC, GaN), des Komponentenlebenszyklus und des Obsoleszenzmanagements; Implementierung von Last-Time-Buy-Strategien.
  • Kosteneinsparungen im Jahresvergleich durch Volumenkonsolidierung, wettbewerbsfähige Beschaffung, Design-to-Cost- und VA/VE-Initiativen.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering- und NPI-Teams weltweit, um die Komponentenauswahl zu beeinflussen und die strategische Ausrichtung vom Produktkonzept bis zur Massenproduktion sicherzustellen.
  • Verwalten Sie den End-to-End-Kontraktlebenszyklus: Erstellung, Überprüfung, Ausführung und Compliance-Überwachung.
  • Melden Sie die Performance der Kategorie (Kosteneinsparungen, OTD, Qualität, Risiko) regelmäßig an die Geschäftsleitung.
  • Unterstützung globaler Standorte (Bangalore, Quartino, Richmond, Frosinone und andere) bei der Durchführung lokaler Beschaffungen im Einklang mit der globalen Kategoriestrategie.
  • Vollständige Einhaltung der Beschaffungsrichtlinien von ABB, Trade-Compliance-Anforderungen (Exportkontrolle, Sanktionen) und Standards für Lieferantennachhaltigkeit (ESG).


Key Performance Indicators

  • Jährliche Kosteneinsparungen vs. Ziel (PPV, ausgehandelte Einsparungen)
  • Supplier On-Time Delivery (OTD) und Qualitätsleistung
  • LTA / Rahmenvertragsabdeckung (% der Ausgaben der Kategorie)
  • Single-Source-Risikoreduzierung (Dual-Source-Abdeckungsrate)
  • Supplier Sustainability (ESG) assessment coverage
    • Supplier sustainability (ESG) assessment coverage
    Supplier sustainability (ESG) assessment coverage
    Sie werden einem dynamischen Team beitreten, in dem Sie gedeihen können.



• Qualifikationen für die Rolle
  • Bachelor / Master-Abschluss in Elektro / Elektronik / Power Electronics Engineering, Supply Chain Management oder verwandten Bereichen.
  • 5-12 Jahre Erfahrung in der strategischen Beschaffung oder Kategoriemanagement für Leistungselektronik oder Halbleiterkomponenten.
  • Tiefes technisches Verständnis von IGBTs, Thyristoren, SCRs, Kondensatoren, Sicherungen und Anzeigetechnologien, die in der industriellen Leistungselektronik verwendet werden.
  • Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in globalen Lieferantenverhandlungen, LTA-Management und Kategoriestrategieausführung.
  • Die Vertrautheit mit Leistungselektronikprodukten (Antriebe, Umrichter, USV, Traktion, erneuerbare Energiesysteme) wird stark bevorzugt.
  • Erfahrung mit SAP Ariba, Jaggaer oder ähnlichen Sourcing-Plattformen; fortgeschrittene MS Excel und Power BI Fähigkeiten.
  • Fähigkeit und Bereitschaft, international zu reisen (bis zu 20–30%).
  • Fluent English (obligatorisch); Italienisch, Deutsch oder Spanisch ist ein Vorteil je nach Standort.
  • Professionelle Zertifizierungen (CPSM, CIPS oder gleichwertig) sind ein Plus.

Diese Möglichkeit steht Kandidaten in mehreren Ländern offen, wobei der endgültige Arbeitsstandort auf der Grundlage des ausgewählten Kandidaten festgelegt wird. Da die Vergütung je nach Standort variieren kann, verpflichten wir uns, während des gesamten Einstellungsprozesses transparent zu sein, und teilen die Details der Gehaltsspanne, des variablen Vergütungs- und Leistungspakets mit Kandidaten, die zur ersten Interviewphase für einen Standort in der Europäischen Union gelangen, der von der EU-Richtlinie über Lohntransparenz abgedeckt wird. Das endgültige Angebot wird auf der Grundlage Ihres Standorts, Ihrer Erfahrung, Ihrer Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen, Ihrer Positionierung auf dem Binnenmarkt und Ihrer Ausrichtung auf die internen Standards von ABB zugeschnitten.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner de façon plus rationnelle et plus propre. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir pour grandir, et fier de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez-nous à exécuter ce qui fonctionne dans le monde.

Ce poste relève de:

Global Procurement Manager

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Le Global Procurement Specialist / Global Category Specialist for Power Electronics Components est un collaborateur principal chargé d'élaborer et d'exécuter des stratégies de catégorie mondiale pour les principaux semi-conducteurs de puissance et composants passifs utilisés dans les gammes de produits de l'électronique de puissance d'ABB. Le rôle exige une connaissance technique approfondie de l'électronique de puissance BOMs, une forte acuité commerciale et la capacité de gérer des relations complexes et multi-sites avec les fournisseurs à l'échelle mondiale.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : hybride

Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :
  • Définir et exécuter des stratégies d'approvisionnement de catégorie mondiale pour les IGBT, les condensateurs de films/électrolytiques, les SCR, les thyristors, les affichages et les Fuses.
  • Diriger les processus mondiaux de QRF/FPR; effectuer des analyses de TCO, des analyses comparatives des coûts et des négociations commerciales avec les fournisseurs de semi-conducteurs stratégiques de niveau 1.
  • Élaborer et maintenir des ententes à long terme (ALE) et des contrats-cadres mondiaux avec des fournisseurs clés (p. ex. Infineon, ABB Semiconductors, Vishay, KYOCERA, Eaton, Littelfuse, etc.).
  • Gérer la qualification et l'embarquement des fournisseurs en collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie de la qualité des fournisseurs et de R-D.
  • Analyser les dépenses mondiales, la concentration des fournisseurs et les tendances du marché; élaborer des stratégies à double source et à plusieurs sources pour atténuer le risque d'approvisionnement.
  • Moniteur dynamique du marché des semi-conducteurs d'énergie (silicon, SiC, GaN), cycle de vie des composants et gestion de l'obsolescence; mettre en oeuvre des stratégies d'achat de dernière fois.
  • Conduire des économies de coûts d'une année à l'autre grâce à la consolidation du volume, à l'approvisionnement concurrentiel, à la conception au coût et aux initiatives d'AV/VE.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes du génie et de l'INN à l'échelle mondiale pour influer sur la sélection des composantes et assurer l'alignement stratégique du concept de produit à la production de masse.
  • Gérer le cycle de vie des contrats de bout en bout : rédaction, examen, exécution et surveillance de la conformité.
  • Rapporter régulièrement le rendement de la catégorie (économies de coûts, DTO, qualité, risque) à la haute direction.
  • Soutenir les sites mondiaux (Bangalore, Quartino, Richmond, Frosinone, etc.) dans l'exécution des achats locaux conformément à la stratégie de catégorie mondiale.
  • Assurer la pleine conformité aux politiques d'approvisionnement de l'ABB, aux exigences en matière de conformité au commerce (contrôle des exportations, sanctions) et aux normes de durabilité des fournisseurs (ESG).


Indicateurs clés de rendement

  • Épargne annuelle des coûts par rapport à la cible (PPV, économies négociées)
  • Livraison en temps utile du fournisseur (OTD) et rendement de qualité
  • Couverture du contrat par l'ALT/cadre (% des dépenses de catégorie)
  • Réduction des risques à source unique (taux de couverture à double source)
  • Incidences d'obsolescence du composant et délai de résolution
  • Couverture de l'évaluation de la viabilité du fournisseur (ESG)

Notre dynamique d'équipe
Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique où vous pourrez prospérer.



• Qualifications pour le rôle
  • Bachelor's/Master en génie électrique/électronique/électronique de puissance, en gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • 5–12 ans d'expérience en approvisionnement stratégique ou en gestion de catégorie pour l'électronique de puissance ou les composants semi-conducteurs.
  • Compréhension technique approfondie des technologies IGBT, thyristors, SCR, condensateurs, fusibles et techniques d'affichage utilisées dans l'électronique de puissance industrielle.
  • Expérience éprouvée dans les négociations mondiales sur les fournisseurs, la gestion de l'ALT et l'exécution de la stratégie de catégorie.
  • La familiarité avec les produits électroniques de puissance (drives, convertisseurs, UPS, traction, systèmes d'énergie renouvelable) est fortement préférée.
  • Expérience avec SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, ou des plateformes d'approvisionnement similaires; compétences avancées MS Excel et Power BI.
  • Capacité et volonté de voyager à l'étranger (jusqu'à 20-30%).
  • Fluent English (obligatoire); italien, allemand ou espagnol est un avantage selon l'emplacement.
  • Les certifications professionnelles (CPSM, CIPS ou équivalent) sont un plus.

Cette possibilité est ouverte aux candidats dans plusieurs pays, le lieu de travail final étant déterminé en fonction du candidat sélectionné. Comme la rémunération peut varier selon le lieu, nous nous engageons à être transparents tout au long du processus d'embauche et partagerons les détails de l'échelle salariale, de la rémunération variable et des avantages sociaux avec les candidats qui passent à la première étape d'entrevue pour un lieu dans l'Union européenne, couverte par la directive de l'UE sur la transparence des rémunérations.
L'offre finale sera adaptée en fonction de votre emplacement, expérience, compétences et qualifications, positionnement du marché intérieur et alignement sur les normes internes ABB.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Quality & Continuous Imp Manager

__

We are looking for a Global Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) – Commodity PCBA & Cable, who will be responsible for leading the qualification, development, and performance management of a panel of approximately 10–15 global EMS suppliers located across different regions worldwide.

This position plays a key role within the rapidly growing Critical Power business, driven by the strong expansion of the data center market.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid / remote.

Roles and • Responsibilities:

  • Ensures the execution of the supplier qualification process and that the relevant suppliers are fully qualified and remain compliant with the required standards.
  • Leads improvement projects in collaboration with the on-site Supplier team (Supplier Development)
  • Uses supplier quality management tools and systems for collaboration, reporting, monitoring and disposition of quality, delivery, cost, and compliance metrics
  • Ensure consistency in the process/product controls performed on the different parts purchased from different ABB Manufacturing Units/ Local Sales Unit (LSOs).
  • Leads in promptly addressing supply issues related to quality, deliveries, non-compliant products, or project services.
  • Promotes early supplier involvement in product development activities to maximize capture of supplier innovation and drive improvements in quality, delivery, cost, and risk management.

Preferred • Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electronic or electrical engineering
  • 10+ years of experience in Quality Management roles within a EMS (Electronic Manufacturing Services) Industry
  • Deep product knowledge of IPC Standard. Being an IPC-A-610/IPC-A-620 trainer is considered a plus
  • Proven experience in cross-functional and cross-site Quality management, including RCA methodologies, CAPA processes, and KPI-driven performance management
  • Green Belt of Black belt certifications
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align global teams across different cultures and organizational levels

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the strategic technology direction by contributing your own ideas for identifying, proposing, and implementing innovative technology, software and solutions. Each day, you will assist the Research and Development (R&D) team by executing your assigned tasks and using technical knowledge in a structured way. You will also showcase your expertise by staying abreast of the state of the art and actively applying this knowledge.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Design, develop, and optimize power electronics building blocks and semiconductor functions for traction converter applications, with a focus on efficiency, performance, and operational reliability.

  • Perform electrical and thermal characterization, testing, and qualification of power semiconductors and passive components to ensure robust product performance.

  • Develop and enhance power electronics building blocks for current and next-generation traction converter platforms, from concept through validation and product introduction.

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams across hardware, software, mechanical design, and manufacturing to solve complex technical challenges and deliver innovative R&D solutions.


Our team dynamics

Our power electronics team develops power electronic building blocks and functions for our traction converter families used in vehicles from trams to locomotives, based on the most modern and reliable power semiconductor and gate control technology. We develop the key components for the evolution of our ABB traction products to strengthen our position in the target markets.



• Qualifications for the role

  • Master's degree in electrical engineering (Fachhochschule/University/ETH), with a preferred specialization in Power Electronics.

  • Knowledge of measurement technology and the structure of test arrangements

  • Familiar with standard Office-Software (Word, Excel), as well as with simulation & programming tools (Matlab, Simulink, Plecs, Spice, Python)

  • Good knowledge of German and English, written and spoken

  • Team player with enthusiasm for power electronics and new product development

  • Creativity and quick comprehension as well as independent, structured, and proactive way of working



More about us

The ABB Traction Division is a recognized market leader in drive technologies for rail vehicles, buses, and industrial vehicles, driving innovation in electrification.

Our comprehensive portfolio of high-performance traction, auxiliary, and energy storage solutions – all managed across the entire life cycle – helps to improve energy efficiency and make transportation more sustainable.

Together, we make a difference for our customers every single day. We look forward to receiving your application.

The recruitment process is led by Talent Partner Gema de Vicente.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit, die strategische Technologierichtung zu unterstützen, indem Sie Ihre eigenen Ideen zur Identifizierung, zum Vorschlag und zur Implementierung innovativer Technologien, Software und Lösungen einbringen. Jeden Tag unterstützen Sie das Forschungs- und Entwicklungsteam (F&E), indem Sie Ihre zugewiesenen Aufgaben ausführen und technisches Wissen strukturiert einsetzen. Sie werden auch Ihre Expertise präsentieren, indem Sie auf dem neuesten Stand der Technik bleiben und dieses Wissen aktiv anwenden.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: hybrid

Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich sein für:

  • Entwerfen, Entwickeln und Optimieren von Leistungselektronikbausteinen und Halbleiterfunktionen für Traktionswandleranwendungen mit Schwerpunkt auf Effizienz, Leistung und Betriebszuverlässigkeit.

  • Durchführen von elektrischer und thermischer Charakterisierung, Testen und Qualifizieren von Leistungshalbleitern und passiven Komponenten, um eine robuste Produktleistung zu gewährleisten.

  • Entwickeln und verbessern Sie Leistungselektronikbausteine für aktuelle und Traktionswandlerplattformen der nächsten Generation, vom Konzept bis zur Validierung und Produkteinführung. Zusammenarbeit mit multidisziplinären Engineering-Teams in den Bereichen Hardware, Software, mechanische Konstruktion und Fertigung, um komplexe technische Herausforderungen zu lösen und innovative F & E-Lösungen zu liefern.


Unsere Teamdynamik

Unser Team für Leistungselektronik entwickelt leistungselektronische Bausteine und Funktionen für unsere Traktionswandlerfamilien, die in Fahrzeugen von Straßenbahnen bis hin zu Lokomotiven eingesetzt werden, basierend auf modernster und zuverlässiger Leistungshalbleiter- und Torsteuerungstechnologie. Wir entwickeln die Schlüsselkomponenten für die Weiterentwicklung unserer ABB Traktionsprodukte, um unsere Position in den Zielmärkten zu stärken.



• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Masterstudium Elektrotechnik (Fachhochschule/Universität/ETH), mit einer bevorzugten Spezialisierung in Power Electronics.

  • Kenntnisse der Messtechnik und der Struktur von Testanordnungen

  • Verwandt mit Standard Office-Software (Word, Excel)

  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, geschrieben und gesprochen

  • Teamplayer mit Begeisterung für Leistungselektronik und Produktneuentwicklung

  • Kreativität und schnelles Verständnis sowie unabhängige, strukturierte und proaktive Arbeitsweise



Mehr über uns

Die ABB Traction Division ist anerkannter Marktführer für Antriebstechnologien für Schienenfahrzeuge, Busse und Industriefahrzeuge, die Innovationen in der Elektrifizierung vorantreiben.

Unser umfassendes Portfolio an leistungsstarken Traktions-, Hilfs- und Energiespeicherlösungen – alle über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg verwaltet – trägt dazu bei, die Energieeffizienz zu verbessern und den Transport nachhaltiger zu gestalten.

R&D Team Lead

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'occasion de soutenir l'orientation technologique stratégique en apportant vos propres idées pour identifier, proposer et mettre en œuvre des technologies, des logiciels et des solutions innovants.   • Performer la caractérisation, les essais et la qualification électriques et thermiques des semi-conducteurs de puissance et des composants passifs afin d'assurer une performance robuste du produit.

  • Élaborer et améliorer les blocs de construction de l'électronique de puissance pour les plates-formes de convertisseurs de traction actuelles et de nouvelle génération, depuis le concept jusqu'à la validation et l'introduction du produit.

  • Collaborer avec des équipes d'ingénierie multidisciplinaires dans les domaines du matériel, des logiciels, de la conception mécanique et de la fabrication afin de résoudre des défis techniques complexes et de fournir des solutions de R-D novatrices.


Notre dynamique d'équipe

Notre équipe d'électronique de puissance développe des blocs de construction et des fonctions d'électronique de puissance pour nos familles de convertisseurs de traction utilisés dans les véhicules des tramways aux locomotives, sur la base de la technologie la plus moderne et fiable de semi-conducteur de puissance et de commande de portail. Nous développons les composantes clés de l'évolution de nos produits de traction ABB pour renforcer notre position sur les marchés cibles.

  • Maîtrise en génie électrique (Fachhochschule/Université/ETH), avec une spécialisation préférée en électronique de l'énergie.

  • Connaissance de la technologie de mesure et de la structure des arrangements d'essai

  • Familiar avec logiciel de bureau standard (Word, Excel), ainsi qu'avec des outils de simulation et de programmation (Matlab, Simulink, Plecs, Spice, Python)

  • Une bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais, écrite et parlée

  • Le joueur d'équipe avec enthousiasme pour l'électronique de l'énergie et le développement de nouveaux produits

  • La créativité et la compréhension rapide aussi bien que l'indépendance, la structure et la proactivité de travail

La Division de la traction ABB est un leader reconnu sur le marché des technologies d'entraînement pour les véhicules ferroviaires, les autobus et les véhicules industriels, conduisant l'innovation dans l'électrification.

Leads the Tier 2 Architecture end-to-end Business Solution Design and coordinates development and implementation at the multinational, regional, or global function level, using ABB and/or third-party resources. Leads project execution in accordance with company procedures, relevant cybersecurity regulations and standards, project objectives, applicable quality standards, safety requirements, and cost and scheduling targets. Applies project management processes as applicable.

Core responsibilities:

Project Leadership

  • Leads the team allocated to the project, defines the main guidelines, allocates project tasks, and motivates and monitors internal and/or external resources to accomplish all tasks and milestones.

  • Coaches, develops, and provides feedback to individuals allocated to managed projects. Provides input to the NewGen Resource Manager to support short-term and longer-term development planning for ABB employees.

Instructions and guidelines:

  • Ensures projects follow sound methodology and execution practices in accordance with standard ABB internal directives and procedures, as described in the NewGen PMO Handbook. The project is governed under the ABB Gate Model.

Budget, sales, and operations planning:

  • Keeps up to date and informed about any changes in strategy and is consulted regarding any activities or other projects that have, or might have, a major impact on the project.

  • Develops and gains approval for a business case defining the value proposition of the project.

Project execution and control:

  • Develops a project charter and a project plan (within MS Project) describing how the project will be executed, for communication to project team members and key stakeholders, approval, and as the basis for execution.

  • Organizes, monitors, and controls activities to ensure the effective achievement of planned stage gates and efficient utilization of available resources.

  • Monitors and controls project costs and financials. Identifies, contains, and reduces risks and ensures that all opportunities are captured and acted upon.

  • Formalizes acceptance of the project and concludes all project activities. Prepares handover documentation and training.

  • Manage consultancy partners and solution integrators

  • Plans and tracks all project activities, establishes scheduling risks and opportunities, and delivers projects on time according to commitments.

Stakeholder relations:

  • Serves as the key contact for project stakeholders and an escalation point for project issues.

  • Communicates appropriate information to stakeholders in a timely and effective manner to achieve the desired understanding and support.

  • Develops dedicated stakeholder management and change management plans and applies best practices in change management.

People leadership and development:

  • Develops and manages team members through formal and informal mentoring and coaching.

  • Ensures, in collaboration with the NewGen Resource Manager, appropriate qualification levels of the selected team members.

  • Leads project team members to achieve project requirements, deliver agreed deliverables, and meet the committed project result.

Document management:

  • In collaboration with the NewGen PMO, identifies and plans all document deliverables required by the contractual scope of work and incorporates this plan into the overall project plan/schedule.

  • Tracks document progress and follows up on overdue comments from the NewGen PMO and Gate Assessors.

Key requirements:

  • +15 years of experience in leading the execution of internal strategic business projects at multinational, regional, or global function level, using internal and/or third-party resources.

  • Proven project management practice and experience.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Proven ability to work in international teams.

  • Certification: PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMP, Agile/Scrum certification (e.g., CSM, SAFe), or ABB Program PM Certified according to 2YAD100055 IS Function Standard_IS Project Manager Certification.

We are open to applications from all qualified candidates. However, from a collaboration perspective, we would preferably consider candidates who are already based in Europe.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Warehouse/Internal Logistics Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities


In this role, you will have the opportunity to conduct all activities related to the handling of parts and semi-finished or final products to/from the production line or in the warehouse. Each day, you will be responsible for handling and moving material for production as per guidelines. You will also showcase your expertise by performing warehouse and logistics activities in close collaboration with our internal production teams.


The work model for the role is: Onsite; Baden and Untersiggenthal


This role is contributing to the Motion – Traction division in Switzerland.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Goods receipts handling from our internal shuttle trucks and external deliveries.
  • Sorting, arranging, and storing materials as per guidelines, and picking components for dispatch and final packing on pallets.
  • Executing logistics activities according to established procedures, adapting quickly to new processes as they evolve.
  • Handling goods with various handling equipment, such as forklift or indoor cranes (up to 16 to)

Our team dynamics


You will join a dedicated, service-oriented team at our Untersiggenthal and Baden site. We work in a fast-paced production environment where collaboration with manufacturing teams is key, and where every team member plays an important role in keeping operations running smoothly, while serving various internal customer and stakeholder needs.


• Qualifications for the role

  • You hold a qualification as a Logistics Specialist (EFZ or equivalent qualification), have several years of professional experience in logistics or a production-related environment, and possess a SUVA-recognized forklift licence for counterbalance and pedestrian-operated forklifts.
  • You enjoy working with warehouse and logistics processes in an industrial/manufacturing environment and are quick to absorb and adapt to new workflows.
  • You have a demonstrated track record of reliable, independent working practices and can manage your own workload in a structured environment.
  • You are highly adept in ERP/IT systems (e.g. SAP) and general computer tools – experience with logistics software is a clear advantage.
  • You are passionate about service orientation and customer focus, with a proven ability to prioritize and respond to the needs of internal production stakeholders.
  • You are at ease communicating in German (fluent). Every additional language is an asset.
  • Knowledge in Dangerous Good (ADR/IMDG/IATA) is highly recommended

Benefits


We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Attractive compensation package including bonus, 13th-month salary, and Employee Share Acquisition Program (ESAP)
  • Training, development, and career growth opportunities
  • Contributions toward gym memberships and medical services (IFA)
  • REKA vouchers and discounts through Swibeco
  • 27 to 30 days of annual leave, plus paid company holidays between Christmas and New Year

More about us


ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

In dieser Funktion haben Sie die Möglichkeit, alle Aktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit dem Handling von Teilen und Halbzeugen oder Endprodukten zur / von der Produktionslinie oder im Lager durchzuführen. Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich sein für:

Wir arbeiten in einer schnelllebigen Produktionsumgebung, in der die Zusammenarbeit mit Produktionsteams von entscheidender Bedeutung ist und in der jedes Teammitglied eine wichtige Rolle dabei spielt, den Betrieb reibungslos zu gestalten und gleichzeitig verschiedene interne Kunden- und Stakeholderbedürfnisse zu erfüllen.

  • Sie haben eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz von zuverlässigen, unabhängigen Arbeitspraktiken und können Ihre eigene Arbeitsbelastung in einer strukturierten Umgebung verwalten.
  • Sie sind mit ERP/IT-Systemen (z.B. SAP) und allgemeinen Computertools bestens vertraut – Erfahrung mit Logistiksoftware ist ein klarer Vorteil.
  • Sie haben eine Leidenschaft für Serviceorientierung und Kundenorientierung, mit der nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, die Bedürfnisse der internen Produktionsbeteiligten zu priorisieren und darauf zu reagieren.
  • Sie sind in der Kommunikation auf Deutsch (flüssig). Jede zusätzliche Sprache ist ein Gewinn.

Benefits

  • Ausbildungs-, Entwicklungs- und Karrierewachstumsmöglichkeiten
  • Beiträge zu Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaften und medizinischen Dienstleistungen (IFA)
  • REKA-Gutscheine und -Rabatte durch Swibeco
  • 27 bis 30 Tage Jahresurlaub sowie bezahlte Betriebsferien zwischen Weihnachten und Neujahr

Warehouse/Internal Logistics Manager

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Vous présenterez également votre expertise en effectuant des activités d'entreposage et de logistique en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes de production internes.


Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : Onsite; Baden et Untersiggenthal


Ce rôle contribue à la division Mouvement – Traction en Suisse.


Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Manipulation des récépissés de nos navettes internes et livraisons externes. Les résultats de l'enquête sont les suivants: Tri, arrangement et stockage des matériaux selon les directives, et la cueillette des composants pour l'expédition et l'emballage final sur palettes. Les résultats de l'enquête sont les suivants: Exécuter les activités logistiques selon les procédures établies, en s'adaptant rapidement aux nouveaux processus à mesure qu'ils évoluent. Les résultats de l'enquête sont les suivants: Manipulation des marchandises avec divers équipements de manutention, tels que chariot élévateur ou grue intérieure (jusqu'à 16 à)

Dynamique de notre équipe


Vous rejoindrez une équipe dédiée et orientée vers le service sur notre site Untersiggenthal et Baden. Nous travaillons dans un environnement de production rapide où la collaboration avec les équipes de fabrication est essentielle et où chaque membre de l'équipe joue un rôle important dans le bon fonctionnement des opérations, tout en répondant aux divers besoins internes des clients et des intervenants.


• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Vous détenez une qualification de spécialiste de la logistique (EFZ ou qualification équivalente), avez plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans la logistique ou un environnement lié à la production, et possèdent une licence de chariot élévateur reconnu VUSA pour contrepoids et chariots élévateurs actionnés par des piétons. Les résultats de l'enquête sont les suivants: Vous êtes à l'aise de communiquer en allemand (fluent). Chaque langue supplémentaire est un atout.
  • La connaissance des marchandises dangereuses (ADR/IMDG/IATA) est fortement recommandée

  • 27 à 30 jours de congé annuel, plus les congés payés de l'entreprise entre Noël et le Nouvel An

- Costruire ed eseguire test automatizzati ed integrati utilizzando quadri gTest o simili, applicando le migliori pratiche per la qualità dei codici, la manutenzione e il rispetto di standard quali CRA UE e IEC 62443.

Chapter Lead

__

In this role , you will develop embedded firmware for UPS power supply systems , working across real-time operating systems , microcontroller platforms , hardware interfaces, testing, and cybersecurity compliance. You will help deliver reliable, secure , and maintainable firmware solutions in a global engineering environment .

• Your responsibilities

- Develop, maintain, and debug embedded C firmware for UPS power supply systems using FreeRTOS on ARM Cortex and TI microcontroller platforms, including hardware abstraction layers and interfaces such as GPIO, interrupts, timers, and communication protocols.

- Build and execute automated and integration tests using gTest or similar frameworks, applying best practices for code quality, maintainability, and compliance with standards such as EU CRA and IEC 62443.

- Collaborate with design, testing, and cybersecurity teams to deliver reliable firmware, and use Git, build systems, and CI/CD practices to support efficient software development and continuous improvement.

- Demonstrate ownership, clear communication, and attention to detail while continuously learning and contributing within an Agile engineering environment.

Your background

- Degree in Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field , with 3–5 years of embedded systems or firmware development experience .

- Strong embedded C /C++ skills; experience with Python or another scripting language is a plus.

- Knowledge of ARM Cortex, TI microcontrollers, FreeRTOS , and embedded communication protocols such as SPI, UART, I2C, RS485, Modbus, or CAN.

- Hands-on experience with hardware debugging, firmware integration, Git, build systems, and structured software development practices.

- Experience with industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, Ethernet/IP, CAN, or IEC 61850 , and with HMI panels or HMI design tools .

- Familiarity with Node.js or IoT communication layers, plus understanding of power electronics and UPS architecture, including battery management, power conversion, and thermal management.

- Fluent in English and Italian language skills and Agile experience are considered a plus.

ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader in electrification, delivering smart, connected , and protected power solutions. At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

Contributes to ABB's success with technology, software, product, and/or system development. Identifies and implements innovative solutions to relevant problems. Provides ideas and can work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, products, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

Location: Quartino Switzerland

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Firmware Development: Design, develop, and implement firmware for Power Electronic Converters and communication modules, ensuring robust functionality and cybersecurity
  • Software Quality Assurance: Conduct unit, integration, and system testing to validate software performance and reliability
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with system architects and hardware/software engineers to translate system requirements into detailed firmware specifications
  • Innovation and Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to intellectual property creation and collaborate with global engineering teams to drive continuous improvement and share expertise

• Qualifications for the Role:

  • M.Sc. or B.Sc. degree in Information or Electrical, Power Electronic, Electronic Engineering, Embedded Systems, or comparable field
  • You have at least 3 years of experience in designing control firmware based on microcontrollers / DSPs for Power Electronic Products such as UPS, BESS, Renewable Energy systems
  • You are highly skilled in C/C++/Python and Firmware Development.
  • You have solid knowledge in structured development processes, ranging from requirement analysis, design, and implementation to test and documentation.
  • Experience with development infrastructure, including Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (Git), lifecycle management, build systems, unit testing, debug probes, oscilloscopes, and similar tools
  • Exposure to Cyber Security concepts and knowledge of main industrial communication protocols (Modbus, CAN, EtherCAT) are a plus
  • You are passionate about teamwork and innovation.
  • You are at ease communicating in English and Italian

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world.


Run What Runs the World.

#ABBCareers #RunwithABB

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
